punctuated:
萬曆五年進士登科錄

玉音

萬曆五年三月初九日，禮部尚書兼翰林院學士臣馬自强等於皇極門奏，為科舉事：會試天下舉人，取中三百名。本年三月十五日殿試，合擬讀卷官及執事等官，少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士張居正等六十四員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士張居正〔丁未進士〕
光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、吏部尚書、武英殿大學士呂調陽〔庚戌進士〕
光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、刑部尚書王崇古〔辛丑進士〕
translation_en:
Record of the Metropolitan Graduates of the Fifth Year of the Wanli Era (Wanli wunian jinshi dengke lu)

Imperial Pronouncements

On the ninth day of the third month of the fifth year of the Wanli era (1577), your servant Ma Ziqiang 馬自强, Minister of Rites and concurrently Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and others submitted a memorial at the Gate of Supreme Polarity (Huangji men) regarding the civil service examinations: In the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates from across the realm, three hundred candidates have been selected as successful. For the Palace Examination to be held on the fifteenth day of the third month of this year, it is appropriate to nominate sixty-four officials to serve as Readers of Examination Papers and functioning officials, headed by Zhang Juzheng 張居正, Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Polarity (Zhongji dian). As for the classification and status of the metropolitan graduates, in respectful accordance with the qualifications imperially established by the Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao (Taizu Gaohuangdi): in the First Class, by precedent three candidates are selected, the first ranked as rank 6b, and the second and third ranked as rank 7a, all conferred the degree of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class are ranked as rank 7b and conferred the degree of Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); and those in the Third Class are ranked as rank 8a and conferred the degree of Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen). An Imperial Edict was received: "Approved. Respect this."

Readers of Examination Papers (dujuan guan)

Zhang Juzheng 張居正, Specially Promoted Grandee of the First Class, Left Pillar of the State, Junior Preceptor and concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Central Polarity, was a metropolitan graduate of the dingwei year (1547).
Lü Tiaoyang 呂調陽, Grandee of the First Class, Pillar of the State, Junior Guardian and concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Hall of Martial Valor (Wuying dian), was a metropolitan graduate of the gengxu year (1550).
Wang Chonggu 王崇古, Grandee of the First Class, Pillar of the State, Junior Guardian and concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Justice, was a metropolitan graduate of the xinchou year (1541).

三月十九日，
translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors

In the fifth year of the Wanli reign (1577), early on the fifteenth day of the third month, the Tribute Scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. The Emperor took his seat in the Hall of Imperial Supremacy (Huangji dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early on the eighteenth day of the third month, all civil and military officials attended in court robes, standing in their ranks. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyi wei) set out the Imperial Insignia Procession upon the Cinnabar Steps and within the Cinnabar Courtyard. The Emperor took his seat in the Hall of Imperial Supremacy, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglu si) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names of the graduates. Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the Yellow Placard in both hands, and, led by drums and music, went out past the Left Chang'an Gate to post it on display. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture escorted the Optimus (zhuangyuan) back to his residence with a ceremonial parasol and retinue.

On the nineteenth day of the third month, …

translation_en:
… [The Emperor] bestowed a banquet at the Ministry of Rites (Libu). After the banquet concluded, they proceeded to the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglusi) to rehearse the court rituals.

On the twenty-first day of the third month, [the Emperor] bestowed upon the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) court dress, a cap, and a belt, as well as paper money (baochao) upon all the metropolitan graduates (jinshi).

On the twenty-second day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates in submitting a memorial to express gratitude for Imperial grace.

On the twenty-third day of the third month, the Principal Graduate led the metropolitan graduates to the Temple of the Former Teacher Confucius to perform the ritual offering of vegetables (shicai li). At the memorialized request of the Ministry of Rites, the Ministry of Works (Gongbu) was commanded to erect a stone stele at the Directorate of Education (Guozijian) inscribed with their names.

張嗣修〔貫錦衣衛官籍，湖廣荊州府江陵縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字景仁，行三，年二十四，六月初一日生〕。曾祖鎮〔贈特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，祖文明〔封特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，父居正〔特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、中極殿大學士〕，前母顧氏〔贈一品夫人〕，母王氏〔封一品夫人〕。重慶下。兄嗣文〔貢士〕，弟嗣允、嗣哲〔錦衣衛正千戶〕、嗣弼、嗣淵、嗣信、嗣惠。娶賀氏。順天府鄉試第二十四名，會試第三十八名。

曾朝節〔貫湖廣衡州府桂陽州臨武縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字直卿，行一，年四十三，七月二十二日生〕。曾祖祚，祖寵〔壽官〕，父銳，母李氏。慈侍下。弟朝符〔恩貢生〕、朝簡〔貢士〕、朝策、朝範、朝箴、朝笏。娶黃氏，繼娶劉氏。湖廣鄉試第十名，會試第十九名。
translation_en:
First Class (First Tier), Three Graduates
Conferred the title of Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi)

Shen Maoxue 沈懋學 [registered in a civilian household of Xuancheng County, Ningguo Prefecture, Directly Attached (Zhili); National University Student (guozi sheng); specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jundian; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-nine; born on the fourth day of the intercalary seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Qian; his grandfather was Shen Pu [posthumously granted the title Gentleman for Literature (wenlin lang) and District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father was Shen Chong [Left Assistant Administration Commissioner (buzhengsi zuo canyi)]; his mother was Lady Cui [invested as Child Nurturer (ruren)]; and his stepmother is Lady Ge. His mother (or stepmother) is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). His elder brother is Maoxing [National University Student (jiansheng)]; his younger brothers are Maoguan, Maoqing, and Maoxiao. He is married to Lady Wang. He placed 118th in the [Ying]tian Prefecture [?] Provincial Examination and 81st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Sixiu 張嗣修 [registered in an official household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyi wei), a native of Jiangling County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Jingren; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-four; born on the first day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhen [posthumously granted the titles Specially Promoted Grand Master for Glorious Happiness (tejin guanglu dafu), Left Pillar of State (zuo zhuguo), Junior Preceptor (shaoshi) concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent (taizi taishi), Minister of Personnel (libu shangshu), and Grand Secretary of the Zhongji Hall (Zhongji dian daxueshi)]; his grandfather is Zhang Wenming [invested with the titles Specially Promoted Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Left Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Zhongji Hall]; his father is Zhang Juzheng 張居正 [Specially Promoted Grand Master for Glorious Happiness, Left Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Zhongji Hall]; his father's former wife was Lady Gu [posthumously granted the title Lady of the First Rank (yipin furen)]; and his mother is Lady Wang [invested as Lady of the First Rank]. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His elder brother is Siwen [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier (gongshi)]; his younger brothers are Siyun, Sizhe [Battalion Commander (zheng qianhu) of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard], Sibi, Siyuan, Sixin, and Sihui. He is married to Lady He. He placed 24th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 38th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Chaojie 曾朝節 [registered in a civilian household of Linwu County, Guiyang Subprefecture, Hengzhou Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhiqing; first in seniority among brothers; age forty-three; born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zeng Zuo; his grandfather was Zeng Chong [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father was Zeng Rui; and his mother is Lady Li. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). His younger brothers are Chaofu [Tribute Student by Grace (en gongsheng)], Chaojian [Tribute Student / Metropolitan Examination qualifier (gongshi)], Chaoce, Chaofan, Chaozhen, and Chaohu. He was married to Lady Huang, and remarried to Lady Liu. He placed 10th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 19th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Second Class (Erjia), 57 Graduates:
Conferred the status of Metropolitan Graduate (Jinshi chushen).

Song Xiyao 宋希堯 [Registered as a commoner in Fenyi County, Yuanzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student (Guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shuzhong; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Song Shangzhi 尚質; his grandfather was Song You 祐; his father is Song De 德, and his mother is née Peng 彭氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Xikui 希夔. He married née Yuan 袁氏. He ranked 59th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 18th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Kejiao 陸可教 [Registered as a commoner in Lanxi County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student (Guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jingcheng; forty-second in seniority among his generation; aged twenty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Zhen 震 [Vice Director in the Ministry of War (Bingbu yuanwailang), posthumously honoured as Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices (Taichangsi shaoqing)]; his grandfather was Lu Jinren 近仁 [Unassigned Official of the Seventh Rank (Qipin sanguan)]; his father is Lu Rujia 儒家, and his mother was née Zhang 章氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His elder brother is Kexue 可學; his younger brothers are Keyuan 可願, Keji 可寄, and Keshi 可式. He married née Hu 胡氏. He ranked 35th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 2nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Mengzhen 馮夢禎 [Registered in an artisan household in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student (Guozisheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Kaizhi; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Feng Jing 經; his grandfather was Feng Zhen 震; his father is Feng Di 第, and his mother was née Shen 沈氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Yingzhen 應禎, Yinzhen 胤禎, Yongzhen 永禎, and Guozhen 國禎. He married née Shi 石氏, and took as his second wife née Shen 沈氏. He ranked 29th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 1st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Tingjie 劉庭芥 [registered under military household status in Zhangpu County 漳浦縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian 福建; a County Student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jiezheng 介徵, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Xie 劉渫, his grandfather Liu Juyi 劉居易, his father Liu Xiangluan 劉祥鸞, and his mother Lady Shen 沈氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Tinghui 庭蕙, Tingqu 庭𡎊 [?], Tinglan 庭蘭, Tinglü 庭𡎚 [?], Tingxuan 庭萱, Tingava 庭茼, and Tingjing 庭荆. He is married to Lady Chen 陳氏. He placed sixteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Qiyuan 楊起元 [registered under civilian household status in Guishan County 歸善縣, Huizhou Prefecture 惠州府, Guangdong 廣東, a native of Boluo County 博羅縣; a Directorate Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zhenfu 貞復, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Shun 楊順 [Subprefectural Vice Magistrate, promoted in prestige title to Grand Master for Fostering Uprightness], his grandfather Yang Tianchong 楊天𤇍, his father Yang Chuanfang 楊傳芳 [Annual Tribute Student (suigongsheng)], and his mother Lady Guo 郭氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Fuyuan 赴元, and his younger brother is Chaoyuan 超元. He is married to Lady Li 黎氏. He placed first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Dazhong 沈大忠 [registered under civilian household status in Cixi County 慈谿縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Supplementary Student (fuxuesheng) at the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weixiao 惟孝, eighth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the seventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Shouduan 沈守端, his grandfather Shen Zhen 沈鎮, his father Shen Shiding 沈時定, and his mother Lady Zhu 朱氏. Both his parents are living. He is married to Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed eighteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Dezheng 楊德政 [registered under civilian household status in Yin County 鄞縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; a Directorate Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Gongliang 公亮, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the thirtieth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Maoyuan 楊茂元 [Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Minister of Justice], his grandfather Yang Meibian 楊美弁 [Directorate Student (jiansheng)], his father Yang Chengbin 楊承賓, and his mother Lady Yu 俞氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Dezi 德孜 and Deqi 德啟. He is married to Lady Shu 舒氏. He placed sixteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

盛世承〔貫直隸安慶府桐城縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字以烈，行七，年二十六，七月初五日生〕。曾祖健；祖儀〔封御史，贈都察院右僉都御史〕；父汝謙〔戶部右侍郎〕；前母王氏〔贈恭人〕；母房氏〔封恭人〕。具慶下。兄世臯〔監生〕、世夔〔歲貢生〕、世楫、世霖、世翼〔貢士〕；弟世享。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第二十六名，會試第二百四名。

張問仁〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字爲春，行一，年三十七，正月十三日生〕。曾祖國維；祖景暘；父敭；母許氏。慈侍下。弟問達、問士、問政、問禮。娶蔡氏。順天府鄉試第三十六名，會試第一百六十一名。

鄭一麟〔貫浙江紹興府山陰縣民籍，上虞縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字世禎，行一，年三十，十二月初六日生〕。曾祖貴；祖遂〔典史，贈文林郎、知縣〕；父舜臣〔知府〕；母胡氏〔封孺人〕；生母辛氏。具慶下。弟一鳳〔監生〕、一驥〔監生〕、一鵾、一蛟、一鶚、一鰲。娶朱氏。浙江鄉試第二十六名，會試第一百二十五名。
translation_en:
Zhang Wenqi 張文奇 [registered under artisan household status in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanzheng; third in generational order; aged thirty; born on the tenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Ming [invested as District Magistrate]; his grandfather was Zhang Bian [Department Magistrate]; his father is Zhang Gongcai [National University Student]; and his mother is née Chen. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wenbing and Wenli; his younger brothers are Wenhuan and Wenzhen. He married née Zhou, and subsequently married née Chen. He placed 44th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 43rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sheng Shicheng 盛世承 [registered under civilian household status in Tongcheng County, Anqing Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); County School Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yilie; seventh in generational order; aged twenty-six; born on the fifth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Sheng Jian; his grandfather was Sheng Yi [invested as Investigating Censor, posthumously honoured as Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate]; his father is Sheng Ruqian [Right Vice Minister of Revenue]; his father's former wife was née Wang [posthumously honoured as Lady of Respectfulness (Gongren)]; and his mother is née Fang [invested as Lady of Respectfulness (Gongren)]. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Shigao [National University Student], Shikui [Annual Tribute Student], Shiji, Shilin, and Shiyi [Tribute Scholar]; his younger brother is Shixiang. He married née Wu. He placed 26th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 204th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenren 張問仁 [registered under artisan household status in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weichun; first in generational order; aged thirty-seven; born on the thirteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Guowei; his grandfather was Zhang Jingyang; his father was Zhang Yang; and his mother is née Xu. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Wenda, Wenshi, Wenzheng, and Wenli. He married née Cai. He placed 36th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 161st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Yilin 鄭一麟 [registered under civilian household status in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, originally from Shangyu County; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shizhen; first in generational order; aged thirty; born on the sixth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Gui; his grandfather was Zheng Sui [District Jailor, posthumously honoured as Gentleman for Literature and District Magistrate]; his father is Zheng Shunchen [Prefect]; his principal mother is née Hu [invested as Child Nurturess (Ruren)]; and his birth mother is née Xin. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yifeng [National University Student], Yiji [National University Student], Yikun, Yijiao, Yi'e, and Yi'ao. He married née Zhu. He placed 26th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 125th in the Metropolitan Examination.

蘇濬〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣鹽籍，國子生，治《易經》，字君禹，行二，年三十五，十二月二十九日生〕。曾祖柏；祖顯；父玉，前母陳氏、母陳氏。嚴侍下。兄瀚，弟舜臣〔貢士〕、際、裴。娶柯氏。福建鄉試第一名，會試第十四名。

黃學顏〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子愚，行三，年三十五，八月二十日生〕。曾祖鵠；祖閣〔恩例冠帶〕；父佐，母趙氏。具慶下。兄學曾、學閔，弟學雍、學思〔貢士〕、學孟。娶陶氏，繼娶詹氏。應天府鄉試第二十九名，會試第二百十六名。

尤光被〔貫福建福州府羅源縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子輝，行三，年二十七，六月十六日生〕。曾祖紳；祖巖；父仁策，母林氏。具慶下。兄光祖、光祿，弟光祉。娶林氏。福建鄉試第三十七名，會試第六十一名。

李元齡〔貫四川成都府華陽縣民籍，江西南昌府豐城縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字仁卿，行一，年二十九，正月十六日生〕。曾祖福；祖大榮；父廷聲，母曹氏。具慶下。弟亨齡、貞齡。娶張氏。四川鄉試第四十九名，會試第五十七名。
translation_en:
Su Jun 蘇濬 (courtesy name Junyu 君禹, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month) is registered under a salt-household status in Jinjiang County 晉江縣, Quanzhou Prefecture 泉州府, Fujian 福建. He is a Student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經). His great-grandfather was Su Bo 蘇柏; his grandfather was Su Xian 蘇顯; his father is Su Yu 蘇玉; his father's former wife was Madam Chen 陳氏, and his mother was Madam Chen 陳氏. His father is living while his mother is deceased. He has an elder brother, Su Han 蘇瀚, and younger brothers, Su Shunchen 蘇舜臣 (Tribute Student [gongshi 貢士]), Su Ji 蘇際, and Su Pei 蘇裴. He married Madam Ke 柯氏. He placed first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Xueyan 黃學顏 (courtesy name Ziyu 子愚, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month) is registered under a commoner household status in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸). He is a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經). His great-grandfather was Huang Hu 黃鵠; his grandfather was Huang Ge 黃閣 (granted cap and belt by grace regulation); his father is Huang Zuo 黃佐, and his mother is Madam Zhao 趙氏. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers, Huang Xuezeng 黃學曾 and Huang Xuemin 黃學閔, and younger brothers, Huang Xueyong 黃學雍, Huang Xuesi 黃學思 (Tribute Student), and Huang Xuemeng 黃學孟. He married Madam Tao 陶氏, and took Madam Zhan 詹氏 as his second wife. He placed twenty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

You Guangbei 尤光被 (courtesy name Zihui 子輝, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month) is registered under a military household status in Luoyuan County 羅源縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建. He is a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經). His great-grandfather was You Shen 尤紳; his grandfather was You Yan 尤巖; his father is You Rence 尤仁策, and his mother is Madam Lin 林氏. Both of his parents are living. He has elder brothers, You Guangzu 尤光祖 and You Guanglu 尤光祿, and a younger brother, You Guangzhi 尤光祉. He married Madam Lin 林氏. He placed thirty-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yuanling 李元齡 (courtesy name Renqing 仁卿, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the sixteenth day of the first month) is registered under a commoner household status in Huayang County 華陽縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan 四川, with ancestral origins in Fengcheng County 豐城縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西. He is a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing 詩經). His great-grandfather was Li Fu 李福; his grandfather was Li Darong 李大榮; his father is Li Tingsheng 李廷聲, and his mother is Madam Cao 曹氏. Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers, Li Hengling 李亨齡 and Li Zhenling 李貞齡. He married Madam Zhang 張氏. He placed forty-ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

許國瓚〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣軍籍，府學附學生，治《書經》，字鼎卿，行二，年二十六，十二月十九日生〕。曾祖純〔壽官〕，祖鳳，父執中，母丘氏。重慶下，兄國誠〔貢士〕，弟國誼、國謨，娶李氏。福建鄉試第十七名，會試第二百十五名。
楊際會〔貫廣西梧州府容縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字士遇，行一，年二十四，十月二十日生〕。曾祖春〔府照磨〕，祖禮〔義官〕，父繼武，母馮氏。重慶下，兄際魁〔訓導〕、際明〔藎臣〕、際儒、際熈〔知縣〕、際顯、際選、際治，弟際昌，娶李氏。廣西鄉試第四十一名，會試第八十七名。

Zhao Jian 趙健 (registered in a military household in Jing County, Ningguo Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhongfu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the tenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Chi (Philanthropic Official), his grandfather was Zhao Jue, his father was Zhao Quan (a Government Student granted the privilege of wearing an official cap and belt), his mother was Lady Zheng, and his stepmother was Lady Zhu. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Zhao Jia, and younger brothers, Zhao Shen (Tribute Student), Zhao Fu, and Zhao Bo. He married Lady Zheng. He placed fifty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zaiping 王再聘 (registered in a military household in Linyi County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Renzhi; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the seventeenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Wang Sheng, his grandfather was Wang Lu, his father was Wang Fu, his father's former wife was Lady Zhang, and his mother was Lady Wang. His mother is living. He has elder brothers, Wang Laiping (Assistant Instructor, granted by titular conferment the prestige title of Office Manager in the Ministry of Personnel) and Wang Sanping (Expectant Sacrificial Attendant). He married Lady Zhang. He placed third in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Guozan 許國瓚 (registered in a military household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; an Added Student of the prefectural Confucian school; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Dingqing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Chun (Longevity Official), his grandfather was Xu Feng, his father was Xu Zhizhong, and his mother was Lady Qiu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has an elder brother, Xu Guocheng (Tribute Student), and younger brothers, Xu Guoyi and Xu Guomo. He married Lady Li. He placed seventeenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Jihui 楊際會 (registered in a civilian household in Rong County, Wuzhou Prefecture, Guangxi; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Shiyu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Chun (Prefectural Record Keeper), his grandfather was Yang Li (Philanthropic Official), his father was Yang Jiwu, and his mother was Lady Feng. Both his parents and grandparents are living. He has elder brothers [cousins], Yang Jikui (Assistant Instructor), Yang Jiming (Jinchen [?]), Yang Jiru, Yang Jixi (County Magistrate), Yang Jixian, Yang Jixuan, and Yang Jizhi, and a younger brother, Yang Jichang. He married Lady Li. He placed forty-first in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

沈九疇〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字箕仲，行二，年三十六，二月初十日生〕。曾祖津；祖文榮；父熺；母李氏。嚴侍下。兄九韶，弟九苞、九章、當戶。娶洪氏，繼娶謝氏。浙江鄉試第八十二名，會試第一百十二名。
translation_en:
Yu Dazhen 于達真 (registered under civilian household status in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zichong; second in his generation; thirty-one [transcribed 天三十一, error for 年三十一] years of age, born on the twelfth day of the intercalary ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Jun, his grandfather was Yu Qing, his father was Yu Pu (Honorary Official for Longevity), his legal mother was Lady Qin, and his birth mother is Lady Shi. His mother is living. His elder brother is Yu Lian. He married Lady Wang, and remarried Lady Geng. He placed forty-second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Shouqin 唐守欽 (registered under salt-producer household status in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongyao; first in his generation; twenty-nine years of age, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Tang Kongmei, his grandfather was Tang Zhen (Honorary Official for Longevity), his father was Tang Qiaoxuan, his father's former wife was Lady Li, and his mother is Lady Chen. His mother is living. His younger brother is Tang Yue. He married Lady Cheng. He placed fifty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Qi 馮琦 (registered under military household status in Linqu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, originally from Guangning Left Guard in Liaodong; a Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongyun; second in his generation; twenty years of age, born on the twenty-third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Feng Yu (Surveillance Vice Commissioner, posthumously honored as Right Administration Commissioner), his grandfather was Feng Weizhong (Messenger, posthumously honored as Secretary in the Ministry of War), his father is Feng Zilü (Surveillance Vice Commissioner), and his mother is Lady Song (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Feng Zhang, and his younger brothers are Feng Xun, Feng Yuan, Feng Xuan, Feng Ji, Feng Cong, Feng Sui, Feng Wan, and Feng Ke. He married Lady Jiang. He placed tenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred seventeenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Jiuchou 沈九疇 (registered under civilian household status in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jizhong; second in his generation; thirty-six years of age, born on the tenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Shen Jin, his grandfather was Shen Wenrong, his father is Shen Xi, and his mother was Lady Li. His father is living. His elder brother is Shen Jiushao, and his younger brothers are Shen Jiubao, Shen Jiuzhang, and Shen Danghu. He married Lady Hong, and remarried Lady Xie. He placed eighty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Wang Mingshi 王明時 (registered in a civilian household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a supernumerary student of the Prefectural School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhifu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the seventh day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Wang Zhao; his grandfather was Wang Kan; his father was Wang Qifang, and his mother was née He. Both of his parents are living. He married née Peng. He placed sixty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Chengtai 孫成泰 (registered in a civilian household of Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education [Guozisheng]; specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Yunjiao; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Xuan (invested as Registrar of the Nanjing Court of the Imperial Clan, and posthumously promoted by successive grants to Grandee for Assisting Governance and Nanjing Minister of Justice); his grandfather was Sun Xi (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, and posthumously promoted by successive grants to Grandee for Assisting Governance and Nanjing Minister of Justice); his father was Sun Zhi (Grandee for Assisting Governance and Nanjing Minister of Justice), his father's former wife (qianmu) was née Shen (posthumously promoted by successive grants to Lady [Furen]), and his mother was née Ye (invested by successive grants as Lady [Furen]). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Sun Chengxian (Student by Yin Privilege [guansheng]), Sun Chengming (Directorate Student [jiansheng]), Sun Chenglun (Directorate Student), Sun Chengwen (Directorate Student), and Sun Chengji (Directorate Student). He married née Tang. He placed thirty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yu 王豫 (registered in a civilian household of Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Prefectural School; specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Jiefu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Wan; his grandfather was Wang Song; his father was Wang Laipin, and his mother was née Chen. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Fu, Wang Shi, and Wang Qian (Tribute Student [gongshi]), and his younger brothers are Wang Sui, Wang Ding, Wang Jin, Wang Huan, and Wang Zhen. He married née Zhou. He placed fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Shigu 郭師古 (registered in a military household of Rugao County, Taizhou Subprefecture, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shiyong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Guo Long; his grandfather was Guo Fu; his father was Guo Zongyi, and his mother was née Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Guo Shide, Guo Shizhen, Guo Shikui, Guo Shiyin, and Guo Shidao. He married née Chen. He placed one hundred and second in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
周汝登〔貫浙江紹興府嵊縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字繼元，行三，年三十一，閏九月十一日生〕。曾祖岑〔壽官〕，祖河，父謨〔訓導〕，嫡母丁氏，生母黃氏。慈侍下。兄訓、珪、汝強〔庫大使〕、夢秀、汝思、夢熊。娶王氏。浙江鄉試第三十一名，會試第一百二十二名。
劉九澤〔貫直隸延慶州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝濟，行四，年二十八，四月十八日生〕。曾祖清〔場官〕，祖珊，父俊，母王氏。慈侍下。兄九江〔監生〕、九淵〔監生〕、九湖，弟九河。娶馬氏。順天府鄉試第一百九名，會試第九十四名。
章潤〔貫直隸揚州府江都縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字實甫，行一，年三十四，七月初八日生〕。曾祖聰，祖輪，父鑰，前母余氏、蕭氏，母胡氏。永感下。娶丁氏，繼娶虞氏。應天府鄉試第十五名，會試第一百七十九名。
房守士〔貫山東濟南府齊河縣軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字升甫，行二，年四十一，七月初一日生〕。曾祖迪，祖璿，父巍，母王氏。永感下。兄守儒，弟守約、應宿。娶劉氏。順天府鄉試第六名，會試第四十五名。
translation_en:
Zhou Rudeng 周汝登 (registered in a military household of Shengxian 嵊縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang; National University Student [guozi sheng]; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jiyuan 繼元; third in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the eleventh day of the intercalary ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Cen 周岑 (Honorary Elder [shouguan]), his grandfather was Zhou He 周河, his father was Zhou Mo 周謨 (Assistant Instructor [xundao]), his legal mother was Lady Ding 丁氏, and his birth mother is Lady Huang 黃氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhou Xun 周訓, Zhou Gui 周珪, Zhou Ruqiang 周汝強 (Treasury Commissioner-in-chief [ku dashi]), Zhou Mengxiu 周夢秀, Zhou Rusi 周汝思, and Zhou Mengxiong 周夢熊. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed thirty-first in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jiuze 劉九澤 (registered in a civilian household of Yanqing Subprefecture 延慶州, Zhili; National University Student [guozi sheng]; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ruji 汝濟; fourth in seniority; aged twenty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Qing 劉清 (Yard Official [changguan]), his grandfather was Liu Shan 劉珊, his father was Liu Jun 劉俊, and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Liu Jiujiang 劉九江 (National University Student [jiansheng]), Liu Jiuyuan 劉九淵 (National University Student [jiansheng]), and Liu Jiuhu 劉九湖, and his younger brother is Liu Jiuhe 劉九河. He married Lady Ma 馬氏. He placed one hundred ninth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Run 章潤 (registered in a military household of Jiangdu County 江都縣, Yangzhou Prefecture 揚州府, Zhili; National University Student [guozi sheng]; specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Shifu 實甫; first in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Cong 章聰, his grandfather was Zhang Lun 章輪, his father was Zhang Yao 章鑰, his father's former wives were Lady Yu 余氏 and Lady Xiao 蕭氏, and his mother was Lady Hu 胡氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Lady Ding 丁氏, and remarried Lady Yu 虞氏. He placed fifteenth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Shoushi 房守士 (registered in a military household of Qihe County 齊河縣, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong; National University Student [guozi sheng]; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shengfu 升甫; second in seniority; aged forty-one, born on the first day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Fang Di 房迪, his grandfather was Fang Xuan 房璿, his father was Fang Wei 房巍, and his mother was Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Fang Shouru 房守儒, and his younger brothers are Fang Shouyue 房守約 and Fang Yingsu 房應宿. He married Lady Liu 劉氏. He placed sixth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
李楠〔貫山西太原府代州崞縣軍籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字子梁，行一，年二十一，八月十一日生〕。曾祖珩〔府經歷〕；祖本明〔府教授〕；父三畏，母張氏。具慶下。弟采、棨、棐、杲、樌、藻。娶郭氏。山西鄉試第十四名，會試第一百七十八名。

蔡斗移〔貫湖廣黃州府蘄水縣軍籍，縣學生，治《春秋》，字元運，行四，年三十，正月初八日生〕。曾祖霖；祖昇；父月濂〔王府良醫〕，嫡母裴氏，生母黃氏。慈侍下。兄斗庚、斗昭，弟斗瑞、斗麗。娶易氏，繼娶王氏。湖廣鄉試第四名，會試第二百十二名。

沈季文〔貫浙江湖州府烏程縣民籍，直隸蘇州府吳江縣人，國子生，治《禮記》，字少卿，行六，年二十二，六月二十六日生〕。曾祖經〔醫正，醫學訓科，贈知府〕；祖岱〔監生〕；父理〔監生〕，母黃氏。嚴侍下。兄孚聞〔同科進士〕、令善〔監生〕、令成、令猷、嘉聞。娶金氏。順天府鄉試第二名，會試第三名。

莊履豐〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣鹽籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字中煕，行一，年二十八，十月三十日生〕。曾祖旺〔封吏部員外郎〕；祖一俊〔布政司左參議〕；父望槐，母丘氏，繼母褚氏。具慶下。弟履朋〔貢士〕、履揆、履隆、履源、履斗、履萬、履甲、履秀。娶陳氏。福建鄉試第十三名，會試第一百八十九名。
translation_en:
Li Nan 李楠 [Registered in a military household in Guo County, Dai Subprefecture, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; County Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Ziliang; first in his generation; aged twenty-one, born on the eleventh day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Heng [Prefectural Registrar]; his grandfather was Li Benming [Prefectural Instructor]; his father is Li Sanwei, and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Cai, Li Qi, Li Fei, Li Gao, Li Guan, and Li Zao. He married Lady Guo. He ranked 14th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 178th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Douyi 蔡斗移 [Registered in a military household in Qishui County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; County Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Yuanyun; fourth in his generation; aged thirty, born on the eighth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Lin; his grandfather was Cai Sheng; his father was Cai Yuelian [Physician-in-Ordinary of a Princely Establishment], his legal mother was Lady Pei, and his birth mother is Lady Huang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Cai Dougeng and Cai Douzhao, and his younger brothers are Cai Dourui and Cai Douli. He married Lady Yi, and subsequently married Lady Wang. He ranked 4th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 212th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Jiwen 沈季文 [Registered in a civilian household in Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, and a native of Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Shaoqing; sixth in his generation; aged twenty-two, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Jing [Chief Physician and Prefectural Vice Medical Instructor, posthumously honored as Prefect]; his grandfather was Shen Dai [National University Student]; his father is Shen Li [National University Student], and his mother was Lady Huang. His father is living. His elder brothers are Shen Fuwen [metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination year], Shen Lingshan [National University Student], Shen Lingcheng, Shen Lingyou, and Shen Jiawen. He married Lady Jin. He ranked 2nd in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 3rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhuang Lüfeng 莊履豐 [Registered in a salt-producer household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Zhongxi; first in his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the thirtieth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhuang Wang [invested with the title of Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel]; his grandfather was Zhuang Yijun [Left Assistant Administration Commissioner]; his father is Zhuang Wanghuai, his mother was Lady Qiu, and his stepmother is Lady Chu. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Zhuang Lüpeng [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Zhuang Lükui, Zhuang Lülong, Zhuang Lüyuan, Zhuang Lüdou, Zhuang Lüwan, Zhuang Lüjia, and Zhuang Lüxiu. He married Lady Chen. He ranked 13th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 189th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王謙〔貫錦衣衛官籍，山西平陽府蒲州人，國子生，治《書經》，字子牧，行三，年三十二，九月十二日生〕。曾祖馨〔教諭，累贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、兵部尚書〕；祖瑶〔封刑部主事，累贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、兵部尚書〕；父崇古〔光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太保、刑部尚書〕；母張氏〔累封一品夫人〕。具慶下。兄節〔冠帶生員〕、升；弟益〔官生〕、賁、諟、訥、謹、詠。娶史氏。山西鄉試第三十四名，會試第三十名。
周汝礪〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字若金，行一，年三十五，十一月二十八日生〕。曾祖京〔府通判〕；祖枳；父允中；母唐氏。嚴侍下。弟汝楫、汝霖。娶顧氏。應天府鄉試第一名，會試第一百八十二名。
呂興周〔貫廣西桂林中衛官籍，湖廣武昌府大冶縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字維師，行一，年二十八，六月十四日生〕。曾祖綱〔贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、吏部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；祖璋〔知縣，贈光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、吏部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；父調陽〔光祿大夫、柱國、少保兼太子太傅、吏部尚書、武英殿大學士〕；前母朱氏〔累贈一品夫人〕；母張氏〔累封一品夫人〕。具慶下。弟興齊、興道、興文、興武。娶宋氏。廣西鄉試第九名，會試第八十五名。
translation_en:
Han Qushan 韓取善 (registered in a commoner household in Zichuan County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Kecong; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the fourteenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Han Tai; his grandfather was Han Bi; his father was Han Siwu (an Annual Tribute Student); his father's former wife was Madam Nie; his mother is Madam An. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Han Cuishan (a Prefectural Judge) and Han Mingshan. He married Madam Nie. He placed fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Qian 王謙 (registered in an official household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, a native of Puzhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zimu; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Xin (an Instructor, posthumously honored through successive grants as GrandPreceptor of the Palace Administration [Grand Master for Splendid Happiness], Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of War); his grandfather was Wang Yao (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice, and posthumously honored through successive grants as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of War); his father is Wang Chonggu (Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Justice); his mother is Madam Zhang (invested through successive grants as Lady of the First Rank). Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Jie (a Government Student granted the privilege of wearing official cap and belt) and Wang Sheng; his younger brothers are Wang Yi (an Official Student), Wang Bi, Wang Shi, Wang Ne, Wang Jin, and Wang Yong. He married Madam Shi. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Ruli 周汝礪 (registered in a commoner household in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ruojin; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Jing (an Assistant Prefect); his grandfather was Zhou Zhi; his father is Zhou Yunzhong; his mother was Madam Tang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Zhou Ruji and Zhou Rulin. He married Madam Gu. He placed first in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and one hundred eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Xingzhou 呂興周 (registered in an official household of the Guilin Central Guard in Guangxi, a native of Daye County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weishi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Lü Gang (posthumously honored as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall); his grandfather was Lü Zhang (a District Magistrate, posthumously honored as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall); his father is Lü Tiaoyang (Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Pillar of State, Junior Guardian concurrently Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall); his father's former wife was Madam Zhu (posthumously honored through successive grants as Lady of the First Rank); his mother is Madam Zhang (invested through successive grants as Lady of the First Rank). Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Lü Xingqi, Lü Xingdao, Lü Xingwen, and Lü Xingwu. He married Madam Song. He placed ninth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Dong Yue 董樾: Registered in a civilian household of Yin County 鄞縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang 浙江; a County Student (xianxuesheng 縣學生) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經). His courtesy name is Ziheng 子亨, he is forty-fifth in his generation's birth order, and he is thirty-two sui, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Dong Zhen 珍 (invested with the title of Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue, huke jishizhong 戶科給事中); his grandfather was Dong Yao 鑰 (Instructor in the Prefectural Yin-Yang School, yinyang xunshu 陰陽訓術); his father is Dong Gan 淦; and his mother is née Xue 薛氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Dong Qian 櫏, Dong Cong 樅, Dong Zun 樽, Dong Leng 楞, Dong Fen 枌, and Dong Cheng 檉. He married née Jin 金氏. He placed 58th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 167th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Dagui 諸大圭: Registered in an artisan household of Yuyao County 餘姚縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng 國子生) specializing in the Classic of Changes. His courtesy name is Xinfu 信夫, he is third in his birth order, and he is forty-three sui, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month. [His great-grandfather (name omitted in transcription) was a] County Director of Studies (jiaoyu 教諭) [?]; his grandfather was Zhu Xuan 絢 (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice, xingbu zhushi 刑部主事); his father was Zhu Yingdi 應第; and his mother is née Fan 范氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhu Dachuan 大川, Zhu Dalun 大倫 (Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for War, bingke jishizhong 兵科給事中), and Zhu Daben 大本 (District Magistrate, zhixian 知縣); his younger brothers are Zhu Dajiao 大交 and Zhu Dabi 大陛. He married née Fan 范氏. He placed 1st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 46th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Shouyue 李守約: Registered in a military household of Gong'an County 公安縣, Jingzhou Prefecture 荊州府, Huguang 湖廣; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing 書經). His courtesy name is Shanfu 善夫, he is third in his birth order, and he is thirty-one sui, born on the second day of the intercalary ninth month. [Great-grandfather omitted in transcription;] his grandfather is Li Daben 大本 (District Magistrate, posthumously/honorarily granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, hubu zhushi 戶部主事); his father is Li Ruo 若 [?]; and his mother is née Deng 鄧氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Li Shouren 守仁, Li Qian 謙, Li Shouyi 守義, and Li Hui 會; his younger brothers are Li Qian 乾, Li Jian 漸, Li Sheng 升, Li Fu 孚, and Li Shoumu 守牧. He married née Gao 高氏. He placed 20th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 24th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Younian 鄭有年: Registered in a civilian household of Xi'an County 西安縣, Quzhou Prefecture 衢州府, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes. His courtesy name is Guorui 國瑞, he is ninth in his birth order, and he is thirty-five sui, born on the first day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Zheng Luan 鑾; his grandfather was Zheng Sui 橞; his father is Zheng Cang 滄 (granted cap and belt by grace precedent, enli guandai 恩例冠帶); and his mother is née Fu 傅氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Zheng Youzhou 有周 and Zheng Youren 有仁; his younger brothers are Zheng Youfu 有孚, Zheng Youcheng 有誠, Zheng Youdao 有道, and Zheng Youneng 有能. He married née Zhu 祝氏. He placed 30th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 119th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zheng Bi 鄭璧 (registered under a civilian household in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan; an added student of the county school; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; style name Ziliang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zheng Yu (Chief Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial in Nanjing), his grandfather was Zheng Mianchen (Confucian Official), his father was Zheng Yanjun, and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zheng Tai and Zheng Shu; his younger brothers are Zheng Bi, Zheng Zhu, Zheng Gui, Zheng Dong, Zheng Bing, and Zheng Xiang. He married née Zhou. He ranked sixty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yan Bang 閻邦 (registered with the Qunmu Thousand-Household Pasture Office in Huguang, a native of Changsha County, Changsha Prefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Zhidao; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Yan Da, his grandfather was Yan Jing (Master of Ceremonies in a Princely Establishment), his father is Yan Chaojing (Guard Commander by special grace), his legal mother is née Wang, and his birth mother is née Wang. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Yan Jie, Yan Du, and Yan Yu. He married née Wang. He ranked seventy-fourth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Yuanzhu 郭元柱 (registered under a civilian household in Longchang County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan, a native of Fushun County; a student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Zhifu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the twenty-first day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Guo Ding (Longevity Official), his grandfather was Guo Wenming (Prefectural Vice Prefect), his father is Guo Zhenbei, and his mother is née Hu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Guo Yuanhan; his younger brothers are Guo Yuanfu and Guo Yuanping. He married née Cheng. He ranked third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Dou 張斗 (registered under a civilian household in Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; style name Jingbei; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Ying (County Magistrate), his grandfather is Zhang Xi (Longevity Official), his father is Zhang Bo, and his mother is née Lu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Han (Sacrificial Attendant), Zhang Yuan, Zhang Shen, and Zhang Ji; his younger brothers are Zhang Kui, Zhang Bi, Zhang Zhen, Zhang Xin, Zhang Xing, Zhang Xiu, and Zhang Tai. He married née Shi. He ranked fortieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
張鼎思〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字睿甫，行六，年二十八，八月初十日生〕。曾祖敞〔義官〕；祖玨〔義官〕；父元卿〔縣主簿〕；母周氏。慈侍下。兄汝化、汝新、汝熙、洪、燭〔恩貢生〕、炳〔貢士〕、焞、紹芳〔監生〕；弟汝春、其華、煒。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第八十八名，會試第九名。

高尚忠〔貫河南開封府祥符縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字藎卿，行一，年三十一，九月十二日生〕。曾祖宣；祖明禮；父濂；母賈氏。永感下。弟尚德、尚志。娶毛氏。河南鄉試第五名，會試第五十二名。

甘雨〔貫江西吉安府永新縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字應溥，行七，年二十七，三月初十日生〕。曾祖彥〔封承德郎、南京刑部主事〕；祖公亮〔知府〕；父仕可；前母劉氏；母歐陽氏。重慶下。弟丙。娶朱氏。江西鄉試第八十六名，會試第十三名。

劉際可〔貫直隸鎮江府丹徒縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字禮卿，行四，年三十五，七月十三日生〕。曾祖清；祖永節〔典史〕；父燁〔縣丞〕；母唐氏。慈侍下。兄行可〔監生〕；弟時可、獻可。娶法氏。應天府鄉試第六十名，會試第二百七十名。
translation_en:
Zhang Dingsi 張鼎思: Registered in a civilian household of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), he is a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name is Ruifu, he is sixth in generational seniority, and he is twenty-eight years old, born on the tenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Chang (Honorary Official [yiguan]), his grandfather was Zhang Jue (Honorary Official), his father was Zhang Yuanqing (County Recorder [xian zhubu]), and his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brothers are Zhang Ruhua, Zhang Ruxin, Zhang Ruxi, Zhang Hong, Zhang Zhu (Tribute Student by Grace [engongsheng]), Zhang Bing (Tribute Student [gongshi]), Zhang Tun, and Zhang Shaofang (Directorate Student [jiansheng]); his younger brothers are Zhang Ruchun, Zhang Qihua, and Zhang Wei. He is married to née Wang. He placed 88th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 9th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Shangzhong 高尚忠: Registered in a civilian household of Xiangfu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, he is a Directorate Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name is Jinqing, he is first in generational seniority, and he is thirty-one years old, born on the twelfth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Gao Xuan, his grandfather was Gao Mingli, his father was Gao Lian, and his mother was née Jia. Both of his parents are deceased (yongganxia). His younger brothers are Gao Shangde and Gao Shangzhi. He is married to née Mao. He placed 5th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 52nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gan Yu 甘雨: Registered in a civilian household of Yongxin County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, he is a Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His courtesy name is Yingpu, he is seventh in generational seniority, and he is twenty-seven years old, born on the tenth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Gan Yan (granted the prestige title Gentleman for Fostering Virtue [chengde lang] and the office of Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Justice [Nanjing xingbu zhushi]), his grandfather is Gan Gongliang (Prefect [zhifu]), his father is Gan Shike, his father's first wife was née Liu, and his mother is née Ouyang. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqingxia). His younger brother is Gan Bing. He is married to née Zhu. He placed 86th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 13th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jike 劉際可: Registered in a civilian household of Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), he is a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name is Liqing, he is fourth in generational seniority, and he is thirty-five years old, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Liu Qing, his grandfather was Liu Yongjie (District Jailer [dianshi]), his father was Liu Ye (Vice Magistrate [xiancheng]), and his mother is née Tang. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishixia). His elder brother is Liu Xingke (Directorate Student [jiansheng]); his younger brothers are Liu Shike and Liu Xianke. He is married to née Fa. He placed 60th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 270th in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳子韶〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字維咸，行十，年三十二，正月二十日生〕。曾祖允聚，祖膾道，父正舒，母朱氏。嚴侍下。兄子忠、子恭〔貢士〕、子本，弟子選。娶萬氏。江西鄉試第七十九名，會試第二百六十五名。

王之麟〔貫直隸常州府無錫縣軍籍，蘇州府常熟縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝禎，行二，年三十二，九月初八日生〕。曾祖允學，祖寶，父萬齡，母朱氏。具慶下。兄之麒，弟之鳳、之龍、之鵬、之鰲。娶蕭氏。應天府鄉試第八十八名，會試第一百三名。

胡泰〔貫江西撫州府臨川縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字道安，行八，年二十八，九月二十日生〕。曾祖子浩，祖瑞玉，父僑〔恩例冠帶〕，前母饒氏，母甘氏。具慶下。兄復、升、晉，弟益、坤。娶饒氏。江西鄉試第三十九名，會試第一百七十一名。

馬象乾〔貫廣東廣州府連州軍籍，江西吉安府泰和縣人，國子生，治《春秋》，字體良，行一，年二十九，二月十三日生〕。曾祖明，祖應祥，父元東，母黃氏。具慶下。娶鄧氏。廣東鄉試第三名，會試第五名。
translation_en:
Wu Zishao 吳子韶 (registered in a civilian household of Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weixian 維咸; tenth in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wu Yunju 允聚; his grandfather was Wu Kuaidao 膾道; his father is Wu Zhengshu 正舒; his mother was Madam Zhu 朱氏. His father is living. His elder brothers are Wu Zizhong 子忠, Wu Zigong 子恭 (Tribute Student), and Wu Ziben 子本; his younger brother is Wu Zixuan 子選. He married Madam Wan 萬氏. He placed 79th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 265th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhilin 王之麟 (registered in a military household of Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], originally from Changshu County, Suzhou Prefecture; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruzhen 汝禎; second in generational seniority; age thirty-two, born on the eighth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yunxue 允學; his grandfather was Wang Bao 寶; his father is Wang Wanling 萬齡; his mother is Madam Zhu 朱氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Wang Zhiqi 之麒; his younger brothers are Wang Zhifeng 之鳳, Wang Zhilong 之龍, Wang Zhipeng 之鵬, and Wang Zhi'ao 之鰲. He married Madam Xiao 蕭氏. He placed 88th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 103rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Tai 胡泰 (registered in a civilian household of Linchuan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Dao'an 道安; eighth in generational seniority; age twenty-eight, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Hu Zihao 子浩; his grandfather was Hu Ruiyu 瑞玉; his father is Hu Qiao 僑 (granted cap and belt by grace); his father's former wife was Madam Rao 饒氏, and his mother is Madam Gan 甘氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Hu Fu 復, Hu Sheng 升, and Hu Jin 晉; his younger brothers are Hu Yi 益 and Hu Kun 坤. He married Madam Rao 饒氏. He placed 39th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 171st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Xiangqian 馬象乾 (registered in a military household of Lianzhou, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, originally from Taihe County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tiliang 體良; first in generational seniority; age twenty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Ma Ming 明; his grandfather was Ma Yingxiang 應祥; his father is Ma Yuandong 元東; his mother is Madam Huang 黃氏. Both parents are living. He married Madam Deng 鄧氏. He placed 3rd in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 5th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jin Jiong 金炅 (registered in a civilian household of Xinjian County 新建縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi 江西; a National University Student 國子生 specializing in the Classic of Poetry 詩經; courtesy name Yuanhui 元晦; fifth in seniority; thirty-six sui, born on the second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Mengzhen 孟溱, his grandfather was Shenglong 聲隆, his father is Guozhao 國兆, and his mother is Lady Deng 鄧氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Hao 昊, Mian 冕, and Ang 昂. He married Lady Rao 饒氏. He placed third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Great-grandfather Chong [successively posthumously honored as Grandee of the Sixteenth Class (zide dafu), Grand Rectifier of the First Class (zhengzhi shangqing), Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Works]; grandfather Hongjian [invested as Bureau Director, successively posthumously honored as Grandee of the Sixteenth Class, Grand Rectifier of the First Class, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Minister of Works]; father Heng [Minister of Works]; father's former wife Lady Liu [invested as Respectful Lady (gongren), posthumously honored as Mistress (furen)]; mother Lady Liu [successively invested as Mistress]. Great-grandfather Yu; grandfather Ji; father Yilin; mother Lady Ma; stepmother Lady Liu. Both parents and grandparents are living. Elder brother Yingfeng [tribute student (gongshi)]; younger brother Daolong. Married to Lady Fei. 56th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination; 193rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zhengse 黃正色 [registered in a military household of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, originally from Suzhou Guard in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Duanfu; seniority first; age 35, born on the 14th day of the 8th month]. Both father and stepmother are living. Younger brothers Hongxian [Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy], Hongdu [student of the Directorate of Education (jiansheng)], Hongde, Hongshao, Hongxuan, and Hongshou. Married to Lady Tao. 35th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination; 65th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He married née Zhong. He ranked twenty-fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhang Dongxi (Subprefectural Magistrate), Zhang Shaoxi, Zhang Yanxi (Subprefectural Magistrate), Zhang Zhenxi, Zhang Yongxi, and Zhang Jiaxi (County Magistrate); his younger brother is Zhang Chongxi. He married née Wang. He ranked fourth in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Lin 劉霖 (registered in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under military household status; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shipei, third in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, born on the eighteenth day of the third month). His elder brothers are Liu Wenwei and Liu Wenyao; his younger brother is Liu Wenhuang. He married née Lin. 陳瑶〔貫江西南昌府南昌縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字國輝，行十，年三十五，三月初二日生〕。曾祖元金；祖大成；父世博；母熊氏。具慶下。兄琥、瑋；弟琨、理。娶葛氏。江西鄉試第五十五名，會試第一百五十八名。
袁有鳳〔貫福建漳州府漳浦縣民籍，龍溪縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字時儀，行一，年二十七，四月二十三日生〕。曾祖元明；祖弘德；父應文；母蔡氏。慈侍下。兄中清、有鸞。娶莊氏，繼娶陳氏。福建鄉試第四十七名，會試二百三十七名。
王約〔貫福建泉州府惠安縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字伯一，行三，年三十三，六月初六日生〕。曾祖璉；祖奇橙〔知縣〕；父以佐〔教授〕；母陳氏，繼母黃氏。具慶下。兄汝、經、緯；弟紹、純、綸、縉、緒、絅、組、繩、繪、纘、綵。娶連氏。福建鄉試第四十一名，會試第一百三十四名。
translation_en:
Jia Sance 賈三策 [registered as a commoner in Bozhou, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ziyan; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine; born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Jia Yun; his grandfather was Jia Yue [Longevity Official (shouguan)]; his father was Jia Zhu [Longevity Official]; and his mother was Lady Wang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Jia Sanwei and Jia Sanjie. He married Lady Yan, and succeeded her in marriage with Lady Wang. He placed 110th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 282nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yao 陳瑶 [registered as a commoner in Nanchang County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Guohui; tenth in seniority among his brothers and cousins; aged thirty-five; born on the second day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Yuanjin; his grandfather was Chen Dacheng; his father was Chen Shibo; and his mother was Lady Xiong. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Hu and Chen Wei; his younger brothers are Chen Kun and Chen Li. He married Lady Ge. He placed 55th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 158th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yuan Youfeng 袁有鳳 [registered as a commoner in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, originally from Longxi County; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Shiyi; first in seniority; aged twenty-seven; born on the twenty-third day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Yuan Yuanming; his grandfather was Yuan Hongde; his father was Yuan Yingwen; and his mother was Lady Cai. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yuan Zhongqing and Yuan Youluan. He married Lady Zhuang, and succeeded her in marriage with Lady Chen. He placed 47th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 237th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yue 王約 [registered as a commoner in Hui'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Boyi; third in seniority; aged thirty-three; born on the sixth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Lian; his grandfather was Wang Qicheng [District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father was Wang Yizuo [Prefectural Instructor (jiaoshou)]; his mother was Lady Chen, and his stepmother is Lady Huang. His father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Wang Ru, Wang Jing, and Wang Wei; his younger brothers are Wang Shao, Wang Chun, Wang Lun, Wang Jin, Wang Xu, Wang Jiong, Wang Zu, Wang Sheng, Wang Hui, Wang Zuan, and Wang Cai. He married Lady Lian. He placed 41st in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 134th in the Metropolitan Examination.

劉世埏〔貫浙江嘉興府海鹽縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字敬脩，行一，年二十八，十二月十一日生〕。曾祖滂〔封文林郎、知縣〕；祖朮〔刑部主事，贈承德郎、南京工部主事〕；父炌〔按察司按察使〕；母錢氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。兄在〔歲貢生〕、侍臣，弟世坊〔監生〕、世壎、世教、世甄。娶徐氏。順天府鄉試第七名，會試第一百五十六名。

陳性學〔貫浙江紹興府諸暨縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字所養，行六十八，年二十九，正月二十四日生〕。曾祖元功〔王府典膳〕；祖袞〔監生〕；父鶴鳴〔京衛經歷〕；母樓氏，繼母馬氏。具慶下。弟文學。娶駱氏。浙江鄉試第十五名，會試第七十七名。

趙楷〔貫四川嘉定州犍為縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字憲吾，行二，年三十四，三月十七日生〕。曾祖天祿〔贈知府〕；祖時〔行太僕寺少卿〕；父正吉〔監生〕；前母周氏，母朱氏。慈侍下。娶聶氏。四川鄉試第二十六名，會試第二百六十九名。

姚岳祥〔貫廣東高州府化州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字于定，行四，年二十七，十月二十三日生〕。曾祖錦；祖源；父守轍〔教諭〕；前母李氏，母何氏。具慶下。兄應祥、咸祥。娶李氏，繼娶顏氏。廣東鄉試第十四名，會試第一百名。
translation_en:
Liu Shiyan 劉世埏 (registered in a civilian household of Haiyan County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Jingxiu 敬脩; seniority first; age twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Pang 劉滂 (invested as Gentleman for Literature and District Magistrate); his grandfather was Liu Shu 劉朮 (Secretary in the Ministry of Justice, posthumously invested as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Secretary in the Nanjing Ministry of Works); his father is Liu Kai 劉炌 (Surveillance Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission); and his mother is Lady Qian 錢氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Zai 劉在 (Annual Tribute Student) and Liu Shichen 劉侍臣, and his younger brothers are Liu Shifang 劉世坊 (Directorate Student), Liu Shixun 劉世壎, Liu Shijiao 劉世教, and Liu Shizhen 劉世甄. He married Lady Xu 徐氏. He ranked seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 156th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Xingxue 陳性學 (registered in a civilian household of Zhuji County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; county school student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Suoyang 所養; seniority sixty-eighth; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Chen Yuangong 陳元功 (Provisioner in a Princely Establishment); his grandfather was Chen Gun 陳袞 (Directorate Student); his father is Chen Heming 陳鶴鳴 (Registrar of a Capital Guard); his mother was Lady Lou 樓氏, and his stepmother is Lady Ma 馬氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brother is Chen Wenxue 陳文學. He married Lady Luo 駱氏. He ranked fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Kai 趙楷 (registered in a civilian household of Qianwei County, Jiading Subprefecture, Sichuan; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xianwu 憲吾; seniority second; age thirty-four, born on the seventeenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Tianlu 趙天祿 (posthumously invested as Prefect); his grandfather was Zhao Shi 趙時 (Vice Minister of a Branch Court of the Imperial Stud); his father was Zhao Zhengji 趙正吉 (Directorate Student); his father's former wife was Lady Zhou 周氏, and his mother is Lady Zhu 朱氏. His mother is living. He married Lady Nie 聶氏. He ranked twenty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Yuexiang 姚岳祥 (registered in a civilian household of Huazhou Subprefecture, Gaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuding 于定; seniority fourth; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Yao Jin 姚錦; his grandfather was Yao Yuan 姚源; his father is Yao Shouzhe 姚守轍 (Instructor); his father's former wife was Lady Li 李氏, and his mother is Lady He 何氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yao Yingxiang 姚應祥 and Yao Xianxiang 姚咸祥. He married Lady Li 李氏 and remarried Lady Yan 顏氏. He ranked fourteenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 100th in the Metropolitan Examination.

魏允貞〔貫直隸大名府南樂縣民籍，縣學生，治《書經》，字懋明，行一，年三十四，六月初七日生〕。曾祖泰；祖經；父怡〔府通判〕。前母王氏；母楊氏。嚴侍下。弟允中〔貢士〕、允孚〔府推官〕。娶趙氏。順天府鄉試第十四名，會試第七十一名。
translation_en:
Xu Gui 徐桂: Registered in a commoner household in Yuhang County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, and a native of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Maowu, second in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the fourth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Xu Yong; his grandfather was Xu Yan; his father was Xu Guohua (Assistant Prefect). His father's former wives were Lady Chu and Lady Yao; his mother is Lady Shui. His mother is living. His elder brother is Xu Tong (Tribute Student); his younger brother is Xu Geng. He married Lady Jin. He ranked twentieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Yinggeng 韓應庚: Registered in a military household in the Dongsheng Left Guard, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), and a native of Zhaocheng County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Xibai, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the seventeenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Han Wen; his grandfather was Han Cheng; his father is Han Tingyi. His mother is Lady Que. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Han Yingji and Han Yingkui (Tribute Student). He married Lady Liu, and took Lady Hao as his second wife. He ranked one hundred and seventh in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Zhan 俞霑: Registered in a commoner household in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shize, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the eighteenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Yu Jie; his grandfather was Yu Ren (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father is Yu Yan (Subordinate Ritual Official). His mother is Lady Ye. Both his parents are living. He married Lady Lu. He ranked fourteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Yunzhen 魏允貞: Registered in a commoner household in Nanle County, Daming Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a County Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Maoming, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-four, born on the seventh day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Wei Tai; his grandfather was Wei Jing; his father is Wei Yi (Assistant Prefect). His father's former wife was Lady Wang; his mother was Lady Yang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Wei Yunzhong (Tribute Student) and Wei Yunfu (Prefectural Judge). He married Lady Zhao. He ranked fourteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventy-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

顧紹芳〔貫直隸蘇州府太倉州民籍，崑山縣人。州學生，治《春秋》，字實甫，行一，年三十一，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖鑑〔封刑科給事中〕；祖濟〔刑科給事中，贈中憲大夫〕；父章志〔布政司右參政〕；母王氏〔贈恭人〕；繼母孫氏〔封恭人〕。具慶下。弟紹燮、紹芾、紹芬。娶周氏，繼娶陸氏。應天府鄉試第十六名，會試第七十名。

鄭之民〔貫四川成都左護衛官籍，陝西西安右衛人。國子生，治《易經》，字可行，行四，年二十七，九月初六日生〕。曾祖禎；祖棠；父宗仁；母姜氏；生母安氏。慈侍下。兄士偉、應登、應科、士麒、應甲。娶王氏。四川鄉試第五名，會試第三十九名。

王鍵〔貫直隸鎮江府金壇縣民籍。府學生，治《書經》，字德開，行一，年二十八，七月十二日生〕。曾祖杲〔都司都事〕；祖熈；父坊；母范氏。具慶下。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第一百六名，會試第七十四名。

姚元禎〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣民籍。縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字開甫，行四十，年二十三，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖汀〔知府〕；祖稱；父孟禮；母趙氏。具慶下。弟元祺、元初、元福、元祖、元祉。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第七十二名，會試第一百六十名。
translation_en:
Gu Shaofang 顧紹芳 [registered in a civilian household of Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), originally from Kunshan County; a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shifu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Gu Jian 顧鑑 [invested as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice]; his grandfather was Gu Ji 顧濟 [Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice, posthumously honored as Grand Master exemplar]; his father was Gu Zhangzhi 顧章志 [Right Administration Vice Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission]; his mother was née Wang [posthumously honored as Respectful Lady (Gongren)]; his stepmother was née Sun [invested as Respectful Lady (Gongren)]. Both parents are living (having father and stepmother). His younger brothers are Shaoxie, Shaofu, and Shaofen. He married née Zhou, and subsequently married née Lu. He ranked 16th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 70th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Zhimin 鄭之民 [registered in an official military household of the Left Escort Guard of Chengdu, Sichuan, originally from the Right Guard of Xi'an, Shaanxi; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Kexing, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the sixth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Zhen 鄭禎; his grandfather was Zheng Tang 鄭棠; his father was Zheng Zongren 鄭宗仁; his legal mother was née Jiang; his birth mother was née An. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Shiwei, Yingdeng, Yingke, Shiqi, and Yingjia. He married née Wang. He ranked 5th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 39th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jian 王鍵 [registered in a civilian household of Jintan County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a Prefectural Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Dekai, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twelfth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Gao 王杲 [Office Manager of a Regional Military Commission]; his grandfather was Wang Xi 王熈; his father was Wang Fang 王坊; his mother was née Fan. Both parents are living. He married née Wu. He ranked 106th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Yuanzhen 姚元禎 [registered in a civilian household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Supernumerary Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kaifu, fortieth in seniority among his generation, aged twenty-three, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Yao Ting 姚汀 [Prefect]; his grandfather was Yao Cheng 姚稱; his father was Yao Mengli 姚孟禮; his mother was née Zhao. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Yuanqi, Yuanchu, Yuanfu, Yuanzu, and Yuanzhi. He married née Yang. He ranked 72nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 160th in the Metropolitan Examination.
