translation_en:
Huang Jiashan 黃嘉善 (registered in a military household in Jimo County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Weishang; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Zhao; his grandfather was Huang Zheng (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father is Huang Zuosheng (Honorary Official for Longevity); and his mother is née Wang. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Huang Yingshan; his younger brothers are Huang Xishan, Huang Qushan, Huang Jianshan, Huang Shishan, Huang Jiushan, Huang Yangshan, Huang Youshan, Huang Chenshan, Huang Nashan, Huang Haoshan, and Huang Yaoshan. He married née Wang. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yu Jideng 余繼登 (registered in a commoner household in Jiaohe County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Shiyong; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Yu Cheng (title missing in source); his grandfather was Yu Xin; his father was Yu En (Prefectural Registrar); his father's former wife was née Chu; and his mother was née Lu. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Yu Jiqing, Yu Jiguang, and Yu Jixian. He married née Yang. He placed fifteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Shixing 蔣時馨 (registered in a military household in Zhangping County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Defu; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Tai (Annual Tribute Student); his grandfather was Jiang Guozhen; his father is Jiang Chaoliang; and his mother is née Lin. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Jiang Shifen and Jiang Shiyu. He married née Chen. He placed seventeenth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Zhi 楊植 (registered in a commoner household in Yangcheng County, Zezhou, Shanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Erli; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Ben; his grandfather was Yang Luan; his father is Yang Zhang; and his mother is née Ru. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Zhi 楊枝 (Prefectural Assistant Prefect), Yang Dong, Yang Shu (Surveillance Commissioner of a Surveillance Commission), Yang Nan, Yang Wu, and Yang Tong. He married née Liu. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

何洛書〔貫河南汝寧府信陽州民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字啓範，行二，年三十，八月二十三日生〕。曾祖信〔封中書舍人〕；祖景明〔按察司提學副使〕；父立〔府同知，進階奉政大夫〕；母戴氏〔贈宜人〕，繼母王氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下。兄洛文〔右春坊右諭德兼翰林院侍講〕；弟洛英。娶袁氏。河南鄉試第三名，會試第二百五十五名。

劉士瑗〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣民籍，安福縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字允玉，行八，年二十七，九月二十一日生〕。曾祖端；祖潛〔累贈中憲大夫、太僕寺少卿〕；父朝傑〔府通判〕；母曾氏，生母劉氏。具慶下。兄士璘〔儒士〕、士璉〔指揮〕、士球、士珵、士瑀〔監生〕、士珣。娶彭氏。江西鄉試第十二名，會試第二百三十八名。
translation_en:
Ao Wenzhen 敖文禎 (registered in a civilian household in Gao'an County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jiayou; seventh in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Ao Shao (tribute student [gongshi]); his grandfather was Ao Dang; his father is Ao Dunfu; his mother was née Zhou, and his stepmother is née Zou. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Ao Tianzhen. He married née Huang. He ranked 7th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 217th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Wenju 楊文舉 (registered in a medical household in Nanchong County, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan; county student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zhiqing; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the third day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Yang Xi; his grandfather was Yang Mu (posthumously honoured as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Secretary in the Ministry of Justice); his father is Yang Xiu (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner); his mother is née Tang (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Wenxuan and Yang Wendou; his younger brothers are Yang Wenlong, Yang Wenbing, and Yang Wencui. He married née Ren. He ranked 37th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 17th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Luoshu 何洛書 (registered in a civilian household in Xinyang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Qifan; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was He Xin (invested as Drafter in the Central Secretariat); his grandfather was He Jingming (Education Intendant Vice Surveillance Commissioner); his father is He Li (Prefectural Vice Prefect, promoted in prestige title to Grand Master for Governance); his mother was née Dai (posthumously honoured as Mistress of Proper Demeanor), and his stepmother is née Wang (invested as Mistress of Proper Demeanor). Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is He Luowen (Admonisher of the Right Secretariat of the Heir Apparent and concurrently Expositor-in-waiting in the Hanlin Academy); his younger brother is He Luoying. He married née Yuan. He ranked 3rd in the Henan Provincial Examination and 255th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Shiyuan 劉士瑗 (registered in a civilian household in Luling County, native of Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yunyu; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Duan; his grandfather was Liu Qian (repeatedly posthumously honoured as Grand Master exemplar and Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud); his father is Liu Chaojie (Prefectural Assistant Prefect); his principal mother is née Zeng, and his birth mother is née Liu. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Liu Shilin (Confucian scholar [rushi]), Liu Shilian (Commander [zhihui]), Liu Shiqiu, Liu Shicheng, Liu Shiyu (Directorate student [jiansheng]), and Liu Shixun. He married née Peng. He ranked 12th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 238th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Riwen 李日文 [registered in a civilian household of Jinxi County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Weishi; seniority number 227 [?]; age 29, born on the 7th day of the 8th month]. His great-grandfather was Li Jizhuo; his grandfather was Li Hongzhong [Honorary Longevity Official]; his father is Li Kuichun; his mother is Lady Huang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Rihui and Rihua; his younger brothers are Rizhang and Rixian. He married Lady Lan. He placed 60th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 197th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Xin 張新 [registered in a guard household of Zhenhai Guard, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), a native of Xiayi County, Guide Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuanding; first in seniority; age 37, born on the 17th day of the 3rd month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Quan; his grandfather was Zhang Wen; his father is Zhang Huai; his mother was Lady Hong. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Xin, Shi, Ming, Xi, Zhe, and Qi. He married Lady Gui. He placed 56th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Wenyu 李文郁 [registered in a civilian household of Yuzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; Subprefectural Student; specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Xianzhi; first in seniority; age 31, born on the 28th day of the 1st month]. His great-grandfather was Li Gong [Prefectural Instructor]; his grandfather was Li Jinglun; his father is Li Jialu [Assistant Prefect]; his mother is Lady Yin. Both parents are living. He married Lady Shi. He placed 8th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 172nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Shi'ao 胡士鰲 [registered in a military household of Zhao'an County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Erqian; first in seniority; age 31, born on the 24th day of the 8th month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Hongrui; his grandfather was Hu Qing [posthumously honored as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue and Assistant Minister of the Nanjing Court of the Imperial Stud]; his father is Hu Wen [Prefect]; his mother is Lady Deng [invested as Mistress of Peace]. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Shiwen, Shiheng, and Shilu. He married Lady Shen, and subsequently married Lady Liao. He placed 45th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 28th in the Metropolitan Examination.

史繼辰〔貫應天府溧陽縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字應之，行二，年二十六，十二月十四日生〕。曾祖祚〔贈刑科給事中〕；祖徐〔指揮使〕；父隆〔南京鴻臚寺署丞〕；嫡母周氏，繼母蔣氏，生母徐氏。慈侍下。兄繼志〔戶部主事〕、繼書〔錦衣衛指揮僉事〕、繼振〔監生〕；弟繼表、繼褒、繼泰、繼襄。娶李氏。應天府鄉試第二名，會試第二百九十九名。

李國士〔貫直隸鳳陽府亳州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝志，行二，年三十三，八月二十四日生〕。曾祖英；祖杞；父虎山〔壽官〕；母張氏。慈侍下。兄國賢；弟國賓。娶劉氏，繼娶王氏。應天府鄉試第六名，會試第二百八十名。

朱來遠〔貫直隸廬州府廬江縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字文臣，行三，年二十七，八月二十二日生〕。曾祖本澄；祖瓈；父錕〔冠帶生員〕；母薛氏。永感下。兄來聘、來宣；弟來奇、來舉、來謨〔監生〕、來言。娶孔氏。應天府鄉試第九十六名，會試第二百二十四名。

張一德〔貫直隸廣平府邯鄲縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字心得，行一，年二十六，三月初二日生〕。曾祖瀚〔贈文林郎、知縣〕；祖杲〔監生〕；父燮〔儒官〕；母王氏。具慶下。兄一貫；弟一琴、一齒、一鶴、一爵、一劍、一位、一棋、一第、｜書、一夔、一變。娶李氏，繼娶賈氏。順天府鄉試第五十名，會試第二百八十七名。
translation_en:
Shi Jichen 史繼辰 [registered in a civilian household of Liyang County 溧陽縣, Yingtian Prefecture 應天府; National University Student (guozisheng); specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yingzhi 應之; second in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-six; born on the fourteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Zuo 史祚 [posthumously honored as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Justice (xingke jishizhong)]; his grandfather was Shi Xu 史徐 [Guard Commander (zhihuishi)]; his father was Shi Long 史隆 [Bureau Assistant in the Nanjing Court of State Ceremonial (Nanjing Honglusi shucheng)]; his legal mother was Lady Zhou 周氏, his stepmother Lady Jiang 蔣氏, and his birth mother Lady Xu 徐氏. His mother is living (cishixia). His elder brothers are Shi Jizhi 史繼志 [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue (hubu zhushi)], Shi Jishu 史繼書 [Assistant Commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei zhihui qianshi)], and Shi Jizhen 史繼振 [National University Student (jiansheng)]; his younger brothers are Shi Jibiao 史繼表, Shi Jibao 史繼褒, Shi Jitai 史繼泰, and Shi Jixiang 史繼襄. He married Lady Li 李氏. He placed 2nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 299th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guoshi 李國士 [registered in a civilian household of Bozhou 亳州, Fengyang Prefecture 鳳陽府, Directly Attached (Zhili); National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruzhi 汝志; second in seniority; age thirty-three; born on the twenty-fourth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Ying 李英; his grandfather was Li Qi 李杞; his father was Li Hushan 李虎山 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his mother is Lady Zhang 張氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Li Guoxian 李國賢; his younger brother is Li Guobin 李國賓. He married Lady Liu 劉氏, and subsequently married Lady Wang 王氏. He placed 6th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 280th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Laiyuan 朱來遠 [registered in a military household of Lujiang County 廬江縣, Luzhou Prefecture 廬州府, Directly Attached; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Wenchen 文臣; third in seniority; age twenty-seven; born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Bencheng 朱本澄; his grandfather was Zhu Li 朱瓈; his father was Zhu Kun 朱錕 [Government Student with Cap and Belt (guandai shengyuan)]; his mother was Lady Xue 薛氏. Both his parents are deceased (yongganxia). His elder brothers are Zhu Laiping 朱來聘 and Zhu Laixuan 朱來宣; his younger brothers are Zhu Laiqi 朱來奇, Zhu Laiju 朱來舉, Zhu Laimo 朱來謨 [National University Student], and Zhu Laiyan 朱來言. He married Lady Kong 孔氏. He placed 96th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 224th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yide 張一德 [registered in a civilian household of Handan County 邯鄲縣, Guangping Prefecture 廣平府, Directly Attached; County School Student (xian xuesheng); specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Xinde 心得; first in seniority; age twenty-six; born on the second day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Han 張瀚 [posthumously honored as Gentleman for Literature (wenlinlang) and District Magistrate (zhixian)]; his grandfather was Zhang Gao 張杲 [National University Student]; his father is Zhang Xie 張燮 [Confucian Official (ruguan)]; his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both his parents are living (juqingxia). His elder brother is Zhang Yiguan 張一貫; his younger brothers are Zhang Yiqin 張一琴, Zhang Yichi 張一齒, Zhang Yihe 張一鶴, Zhang Yijue 張一爵, Zhang Yijian 張一劍, Zhang Yiwei 張一位, Zhang Yiqi 張一棋, Zhang Yidi 張一第, Zhang [Yi?]shu 張｜書 [?], Zhang Yikui 張一夔, and Zhang Yibian 張一變. He married Lady Li 李氏, and subsequently married Lady Jia 賈氏. He placed 50th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 287th in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄

曾祖鳳〔敎授〕祖賢〔學正〕父建侯〔敎諭〕母張氏

曾祖惟賢〔義官〕祖慶環〔封太僕寺少卿〕父文炳〔南京通政使司右通政〕前母劉氏〔贈恭人〕母楊氏〔封恭人〕

曾祖紳祖世昌父元卿母陳氏

朱廷益〔貫浙江嘉興府嘉興縣籍，嘉善縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字汝虞，行二，年二十七，十一月十九日生〕。曾祖鳳〔敎授〕，祖賢〔學正〕，父建侯〔敎諭〕，母張氏。重慶下。兄廷皐，弟廷龍、廷珪、廷璋。娶施氏。浙江鄉試第十四名，會試第一百九十二名。

黃文炳〔貫福建泉州府同安縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字懋新，行二，年二十九，六月二十四日生〕。曾祖琛，祖軫，父懷，母曾氏。具慶下。兄文敷，弟文燁、文明、文斐、文煌、文炤、文灼。娶柯氏。福建鄉試第十五名，會試第七十三名。

王命爵〔貫江西吉安府廬陵縣民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字元德，行一，年二十九，二月二十日生〕。曾祖惟賢〔義官〕，祖慶環〔封太僕寺少卿〕，父文炳〔南京通政使司右通政〕，前母劉氏〔贈恭人〕，母楊氏〔封恭人〕。重慶下。兄命官〔監生〕，弟命賞〔監生〕、命賜。娶胡氏。江西鄉試第一名，會試第一百九十九名。

蘇酇〔貫直隸蘇州府太倉州民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字漢傑，行一，年三十五，九月十一日生〕。曾祖紳，祖世昌，父元卿，母陳氏。永感下。弟鄴、邴。娶周氏。應天府鄉試第十一名，會試第十五名。
translation_en:
Zhu Tingyi 朱廷益 (originally from Jiashan County and registered in Jiaxing County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Ruyu; second in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Feng (Prefectural Director of Studies), his grandfather was Zhu Xian (Subprefectural Director of Studies), his father is Zhu Jianhou (County Director of Studies), and his mother is Lady Zhang. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Tinggao, and his younger brothers are Tinglong, Tinggui, and Tingzhang. He married Lady Shi. He placed fourteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Wenbing 黃文炳 (registered in a military household in Tong'an County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Maoxin; second in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Chen, his grandfather was Huang Zhen, his father is Huang Huai, and his mother is Lady Zeng. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Wenfu, and his younger brothers are Wenye, Wenming, Wenfei, Wenhuang, Wenzhao, and Wenzhuo. He married Lady Ke. He placed fifteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Mingjue 王命爵 (registered in a civilian household in Luling County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuande; first in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the twentieth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Wang Weixian (Public-spirited Officer), his grandfather is Wang Qinghuan (invested as Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud), his father is Wang Wenbing (Right Vice Commissioner in the Nanjing Office of Transmission), his father's first wife was Lady Liu (posthumously honored as Respectful Lady), and his mother is Lady Yang (invested as Respectful Lady). Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brother is Mingguan (National University Student), and his younger brothers are Mingshang (National University Student) and Mingci. He married Lady Hu. He placed first in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Su Zan 蘇酇 (registered in a civilian household in Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region [Zhili]; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hanjie; first in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Su Shen, his grandfather was Su Shichang, his father was Su Yuanqing, and his mother was Lady Chen. Both his parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Ye and Bing. He married Lady Zhou. He placed eleventh in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐震〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，縣學學生，治《禮記》，字起之，行四，年三十二，三月十二日生〕。曾祖諲〔七品散官〕；祖芬；父禮；母張氏。永感下。兄電；弟霖、霈。娶吳氏。浙江鄉試第九十名，會試第一百四十一名。

李弘道〔貫山西平陽府襄陵縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字汝大，行一，年二十七，二月十五日生〕。曾祖潤；祖遇春〔學正〕；父葆〔貢士〕；母高氏。慈侍下。娶張氏。山西鄉試第九名，會試第一百三十名。

趙崇善〔貫浙江金華府蘭谿縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字汝性，行四十二，年二十九，十月十九日生〕。曾祖庚；祖魁；父懷謹；母郭氏。慈侍下。弟崇德。娶蔣氏。浙江鄉試第六十四名，會試第二百三十名。
translation_en:
Zhu Yinggu 朱應轂: Registered under a military household of the Zhongyi Rear Guard (忠義後衛), originally from Jun County (濬縣), Daming Prefecture (大名府), Southern Metropolitan Area (直隸). He is anAdded Student (增廣生) at the prefectural school, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), with the courtesy name Dezai, first in his generation, aged twenty-eight, born on the eleventh day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Zhu Rong; his grandfather was Zhu Jian, posthumously honored as Gentleman for Fostering Virtue (承德郎) and Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue (戶部主事); his father is Zhu Tianfeng, Surveillance Vice Commissioner (按察司副使); and his mother is Lady Hong, invested as Mistress of Peace (安人). Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Zhu Yingfu. He married Lady Zou. He placed 55th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 250th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Zhen 徐震: Registered under a commoner household in Yuyao County (餘姚縣), Shaoxing Prefecture (紹興府), Zhejiang. He is a student at the county school, specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), with the courtesy name Qizhi, fourth in his generation, aged thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Xu Yin, a supernumerary official of the seventh rank (七品散官); his grandfather was Xu Fen; his father was Xu Li; and his mother was Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Xu Dian, and his younger brothers are Xu Lin and Xu Pei. He married Lady Wu. He placed 90th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Hongdao 李弘道: Registered under a military household in Xiangling County (襄陵縣), Pingyang Prefecture (平陽府), Shanxi. He is a Directorate Student (國子生), specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Ruda, first in his generation, aged twenty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Li Run; his grandfather was Li Yuchun, Subprefectural Instructor (學正); his father was Li Bao, Tribute Student (貢士); and his mother is Lady Gao. His mother is living (his father is deceased). He married Lady Zhang. He placed 9th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Chongshan 趙崇善: Registered under a commoner household in Lanxi County (蘭谿縣), Jinhua Prefecture (金華府), Zhejiang. He is a Supplementary Student (附學生) at the county school, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Ruxing, forty-second in his generation, aged twenty-nine, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhao Geng; his grandfather was Zhao Kui; his father was Zhao Huaijin; and his mother is Lady Guo. His mother is living (his father is deceased). His younger brother is Zhao Chongde. He married Lady Jiang. He placed 64th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 230th in the Metropolitan Examination.

陸承憲〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣竈籍，國子生，治《書經》，字子永，行二，年三十六，十二月十九日生〕。曾祖炳；祖珪；父岳〔監生〕；母袁氏，生母潘氏。永感下。兄承德。娶姚氏，繼娶徐氏。應天府鄉試第十二名，會試第一百八十七名。

張棟〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字伯任，行一，年三十二，四月初四日生〕。曾祖寬〔按察司僉事〕；祖廷臣〔貢士〕；父士瀹〔監生〕；母柴氏。慈侍下。弟柱。娶歸氏。應天府鄉試第五十九名，會試第六名。

李琯〔貫江西南昌府豐城縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字邦和，行十，年三十一，十月初五日生〕。曾祖世碩；祖與同；父萬清；母葉氏，繼母夏氏，生母何氏。具慶下。兄珍，弟珙、玠、珮。娶聶氏。江西鄉試第五十三名，會試第二百四十九名。
translation_en:
Wu Mengxiong 吳夢熊 [native of Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), of commoner registration; a County Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yingwang, third in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Jing 吳經 [Assistant Instructor, enfeoffed as Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy, posthumously promoted to Right Vice Minister of Rites]; his grandfather was Wu Yan 吳儼 [Grandee of the Fourteenth Class (zishan dafu) and Minister of Rites in Nanjing, posthumously promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, canonized as Wensu]; his father is Wu Can 吳驂 [Prefect, advanced in prestige title to Grandee of the Sixteenth Class (yazhong dafu)]; and his mother is Lady Zhang [enfeoffed as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Mengjue and Qimai [? 士邁 Shimai] [Annual Tribute Student (suigongsheng)]; his younger brothers are Menggui [Student of the Directorate of Education], Mengbi [Usher (xuban)], Mengli [Student of the Directorate of Education], Mengsong [metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination], Mengbao [Vice Commander], Mengde [Student of the Directorate of Education], Meng'ao, Menghe, and Mengshen. He married Lady Mao, and subsequently married Lady Jiang. He placed forty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Chengxian 陸承憲 [native of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), of saltern-household registration; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History; courtesy name Ziyong, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Bing 陸炳; his grandfather was Lu Gui 陸珪; his father was Lu Yue 陸岳 [Student of the Directorate of Education]; his principal mother was Lady Yuan, and his birth mother was Lady Pan. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Chengde. He married Lady Yao, and subsequently married Lady Xu. He placed twelfth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Dong 張棟 [native of Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), of commoner registration; a Supernumerary Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Boren, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the fourth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Kuan 張寬 [Assistant Surveillance Commissioner]; his grandfather was Zhang Tingchen 張廷臣 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; his father was Zhang Shiyue 張士瀹 [Student of the Directorate of Education]; and his mother is Lady Chai. His mother is living. His younger brother is Zhu. He married Lady Gui. He placed fifty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guan 李琯 [native of Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, of commoner registration; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Banghe, tenth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Shishuo 李世碩; his grandfather was Li Yutong 李與同; his father is Li Wanqing 李萬清; his principal mother was Lady Ye, his stepmother is Lady Xia, and his birth mother is Lady He. Both his father and mothers are living. His elder brother is Zhen, and his younger brothers are Gong, Jie, and Pei. He married Lady Nie. He placed fifty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄
text:
呂乾健〔貫山西平陽府曲沃縣匠籍國子生治易經字天常行一年三十三八月初二日生〕
曾祖興祖寧父廷玉母王氏
慈侍下弟乾中乾易娶梁氏
山西鄉試第五十三名會試第一百三十五名
吳達可〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍國子生治書經字叔行行三年三十正月二十四日生〕
曾祖經〔訓導翰林院編修禮部右侍郎〕祖儉〔贈光祿寺署丞〕父駉母屠氏〔旌表節婦〕
重慶下兄之遴〔歲貢生〕夢熊〔河南按察司僉事〕達禮〔監生〕達聰〔貢士〕弟達德達義〔監生〕達善達觀達能娶李氏
應天府鄉試第一百五名會試第一百二十九名
===
周盤〔貫山西澤州民籍國子生治易經字𢍰予行二年二十七十月初六日生〕
曾祖廣祖穩父邦〔倉大使〕前母牛氏母魯氏繼母脫氏
慈侍下兄監娶續氏
山西鄉試第二十七名會試第七十九名
伍可受〔貫福建汀州府清流縣民籍國子生治春秋字以大行二年三十一九月十八日生〕
曾祖惠祖𤇍父廷宰〔訓導〕母馬氏繼母龔氏
具慶下兄可願可望可愛〔知縣〕弟可慶可度可交可及可夏娶賴氏繼娶黃氏
順天府鄉試第三十二名會試第一百五十三名

曾祖廣 祖穩 父邦〔倉大使〕 前母仵氏 母曾氏 繼母脫氏
慈侍下 兄監 娶續氏

punctuated:
呂乾健〔貫山西平陽府曲沃縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字天常，行一，年三十三，八月初二日生〕。曾祖興；祖寧；父廷玉，母王氏。慈侍下。弟乾中、乾易。娶梁氏。山西鄉試第五十三名，會試第一百三十五名。

吳達可〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字叔行，行三，年三十，正月二十四日生〕。曾祖經〔訓導、翰林院編修、禮部右侍郎〕；祖儉〔贈光祿寺署丞〕；父駉，母屠氏〔旌表節婦〕。重慶下。兄之遴〔歲貢生〕、夢熊〔河南按察司僉事〕、達禮〔監生〕、達聰〔貢士〕；弟達德、達義〔監生〕、達善、達觀、達能。娶李氏。應天府鄉試第一百五名，會試第一百二十九名。

周盤〔貫山西澤州民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字𢍰予，行二，年二十七，十月初六日生〕。曾祖廣；祖穩；父邦〔倉大使〕，前母牛氏，母魯氏，繼母脫氏。慈侍下。兄監。娶續氏。山西鄉試第二十七名，會試第七十九名。

伍可受〔貫福建汀州府清流縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字以大，行二，年三十一，九月十八日生〕。曾祖惠；祖𤇍；父廷宰〔訓導〕，母馬氏，繼母龔氏。具慶下。兄可願、可望、可愛〔知縣〕；弟可慶、可度、可交、可及、可夏。娶賴氏，繼娶黃氏。順天府鄉試第三十二名，會試第一百五十三名。
translation_en:
Lü Qianjian 呂乾健 (registered in Quwo County 曲沃縣, Pingyang Prefecture 平陽府, Shanxi 山西, under artisan registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tianchang 天常, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the second day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Lü Xing 興; his grandfather was Lü Ning 寧; his father was Lü Tingyu 廷玉, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Lü Qianzhong 乾中 and Lü Qianyi 乾易. He married née Liang 梁氏. He placed 53rd in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Dake 吳達可 (registered in Yixing County 宜興縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸], under civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Shuxing 叔行, third in seniority, aged thirty, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Wu Jing 經 (Assistant Instructor, Historiographer of the Hanlin Academy, and Right Vice Minister of Rites); his grandfather is Wu Jian 儉 (granted the prestige title of Assistant Director of an Office in the Court of Imperial Entertainments); his father was Wu Jiong 駉, and his mother is née Tu 屠氏 (honored with an imperial testimonial as a chaste widow). Both his grandfather and mother are living [重慶下]. His elder brothers are Wu Zhilin 之遴 (Annual Tribute Student), Wu Mengxiong 夢熊 (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of Henan), Wu Dali 達禮 (National University Student), and Wu Dacong 達聰 (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Wu Dade 達德, Wu Dayi 達義 (National University Student), Wu Dashan 達善, Wu Daguan 達觀, and Wu Daneng 達能. He married née Li 李氏. He placed 105th in the Yingtian Prefectural [應天府] Provincial Examination and 129th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Pan 周盤 (registered in Zezhou Subprefecture 澤州, Shanxi, under civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Gongyu 𢍰予, second in seniority, aged twenty-seven, born on the sixth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhou Guang 廣; his grandfather was Zhou Wen 穩; his father was Zhou Bang 邦 (Granary Commissioner), his father's former wife was née Niu 牛氏, his mother was née Lu 魯氏, and his stepmother is née Tuo 脫氏. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Zhou Jian 監. He married née Xu 續氏. He placed 27th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 79th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Keshou 伍可受 (registered in Qingliu County 清流縣, Tingzhou Prefecture 汀州府, Fujian 福建, under civilian registration; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Yida 以大, second in seniority, aged thirty-one, born on the eighteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Hui 惠; his grandfather was Wu Yan 𤇍; his father is Wu Tingzai 廷宰 (Assistant Instructor), his mother was née Ma 馬氏, and his stepmother is née Gong 龔氏. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brothers are Wu Keyuan 可願, Wu Kewang 可望, and Wu Ke'ai 可愛 (District Magistrate); his younger brothers are Wu Keqing 可慶, Wu Kedu 可度, Wu Kejiao 可交, Wu Keji 可及, and Wu Kexia 可夏. He married née Lai 賴氏, and subsequently married née Huang 黃氏. He placed 32nd in the Shuntian Prefectural [順天府] Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄
text:
馬化龍〔貫河南南陽府鄧州新野縣軍籍陝西西安府涇陽縣人國子生治春秋字雲從行一年二十五四月初九日生〕
曾祖恭祖玘父文經母劉氏
具慶下弟見龍登龍夔龍攀龍娶王氏
河南鄉試第五名會試第五十五名
黃承讚〔貫浙江金華府義烏縣民籍國子生治春秋字相孫行二年三十八十二月十七日生〕
曾祖德方〔壽官〕祖翊父儲母吳氏
永感下兄承訓弟承謨承寵承詔娶胡氏

===
祁鯤〔貫直隸河間府阜城縣民籍國子生治詩經字仲化行二年三十一十一月初九日生〕
曾祖釗祖傑〔典史〕父贒〔贈文林郎知縣〕母葛氏〔封太孺人〕

punctuated:
馬化龍〔貫河南南陽府鄧州新野縣軍籍，陝西西安府涇陽縣人，國子生，治《春秋》，字雲從，行一，年二十五，四月初九日生〕。曾祖恭，祖玘，父文經，母劉氏。具慶下。弟見龍、登龍、夔龍、攀龍。娶王氏。河南鄉試第五名，會試第五十五名。

黃承讚〔貫浙江金華府義烏縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字相孫，行二，年三十八，十二月十七日生〕。曾祖德方〔壽官〕，祖翊，父儲，母吳氏。永感下。兄承訓，弟承謨、承寵、承詔。娶胡氏。浙江鄉試第五十九名，會試第一百六十九名。

祁鯤〔貫直隸河間府阜城縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字仲化，行二，年三十一，十一月初九日生〕。曾祖釗，祖傑〔典史〕，父贒〔贈文林郎、知縣〕，母葛氏〔封太孺人〕。慈侍下。兄鯨〔大理寺右評事〕，弟鯉。娶高氏。順天府鄉試第十七名，會試第三十四名。

南兆〔貫山東東昌府濮州軍籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字吉甫，行一，年三十五，十月初十日生〕。曾祖興，祖昱，父良貴，母吳氏。永感下。娶胡氏。山東鄉試第五名，會試第六十七名。
translation_en:
Ma Hualong 馬化龍 (registered in a military household in Xinye County, Deng Subprefecture, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan, originally from Jingyang County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yuncong; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the ninth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Ma Gong, his grandfather was Ma Qi, his father is Ma Wenjing, and his mother is Lady Liu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Ma Jianlong, Ma Denglong, Ma Kuilong, and Ma Panlong, and he married Lady Wang. He ranked 5th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 55th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Chengzan 黃承讚 (registered in a civilian household in Yiwu County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Xiangsun; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Defang (Honorary Official for Longevity), his grandfather was Huang Yi, his father was Huang Chu, and his mother was Lady Wu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Huang Chengxun, his younger brothers are Huang Chengmo, Huang Chengchong, and Huang Chengzhao, and he married Lady Hu. He ranked 59th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 169th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qi Kun 祁鯤 (registered in a civilian household in Fucheng County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhonghua; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Qi Zhao, his grandfather was Qi Jie (District Jailor), his father was Qi Xian (posthumously honoured as Gentleman for Literature and District Magistrate), and his mother is Lady Ge (invested as Grand Child Nurturess). His mother is living. His elder brother is Qi Jing (Right Case Reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review), his younger brother is Qi Li, and he married Lady Gao. He ranked 17th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 34th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Nan Zhao 南兆 (registered in a military household in Pu Subprefecture, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong; a National University Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Jifu; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the tenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Nan Xing, his grandfather was Nan Yu, his father was Nan Lianggui, and his mother was Lady Wu. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Lady Hu. He ranked 5th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 67th in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄
text:
張養志〔貫河南開封府陳州民籍國子生治春秋字子尚行三年二十七六月二十五日生〕
曾祖智祖脉父繼孟〔壽官〕母鍾氏
具慶下兄養廉養性娶吳氏
河南鄉試第七十五名會試第二百二十六名

張養志〔貫河南開封府陳州民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字子尚，行三，年二十七，六月二十五日生〕。曾祖智，祖脉，父繼孟〔壽官〕，母鍾氏。具慶下。兄養廉、養性。娶吳氏。河南鄉試第七十五名，會試第二百二十六名。

史朝錄〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字登之，行一，年三十六，七月二十三日生〕。曾祖亨，祖時用，父宏詢〔知州〕，母黃氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下。兄朝賓〔南京鴻臚寺卿〕、朝寀〔布政司右布政使〕、朝富〔知府〕、朝寯〔戶部主事〕，弟朝鉉〔知府〕、朝英。娶蔡氏。福建鄉試第三十名，會試第二百五十六名。

林休徵〔貫福建興化府莆田縣匠籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字景徵，行六，年二十九，四月初六日生〕。曾祖貴文，祖忠甫，父洪謨，母徐氏。慈侍下。兄重陽〔省祭官〕、景衡、希春、桂香、繼馨。娶蕭氏，繼娶葉氏。福建鄉試三十三名，會試第九十七名。

劉一相〔貫山東濟南府長山縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字維衡，行二，年二十九，十月二十五日生〕。曾祖璽，祖伯能〔壽官〕，父天賜，母高氏。慈侍下。兄一桂〔省祭官〕，弟一杰、一楹。娶孟氏。山東鄉試第七名，會試第七名。
translation_en:
Zhang Yangzhi 張養志 [registered as of civilian household status in Chen Department, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zishang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven; born on the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Zhi 智; his grandfather was Zhang Mai 脉; his father is Zhang Jimeng 繼孟 [Longevity Official]; and his mother is née Zhong 鍾. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Zhang Yanglian 養廉 and Zhang Yangxing 養性. He married a woman née Wu 吳. He placed seventy-fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shi Chaolu 史朝錄 [registered as of artisan household status in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Dengzhi; first in seniority; aged thirty-six; born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Shi Heng 亨; his grandfather was Shi Shiyong 時用; his father is Shi Hongxun 宏詢 [Department Magistrate]; and his mother is née Huang 黃 [invested as Lady of Suitability]. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Shi Chaobin 朝賓 [Chief Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial in Nanjing], Shi Chaocai 朝寀 [Right Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission], Shi Chaofu 朝富 [Prefect], and Shi Chaojun 朝寯 [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue], and his younger brothers are Shi Chaoxuan 朝鉉 [Prefect] and Shi Chaoying 朝英. He married a woman née Cai 蔡. He placed thirtieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Xiuzheng 林休徵 [registered as of artisan household status in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; Supplementary Student of the county school; specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jingzheng; sixth in seniority; aged twenty-nine; born on the sixth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Lin Guiwen 貴文; his grandfather was Lin Zhongfu 忠甫; his father was Lin Hongmo 洪謨; and his mother is née Xu 徐. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Lin Chongyang 重陽 [Sacrificial Attendant], Lin Jingheng 景衡, Lin Xichun 希春, Lin Guixiang 桂香, and Lin Jixin 繼馨. He married a woman née Xiao 蕭, and subsequently married a woman née Ye 葉. He placed thirty-third in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Yixiang 劉一相 [registered as of civilian household status in Changshan County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weiheng; second in seniority; aged twenty-nine; born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Xi 璽; his grandfather was Liu Boneng 伯能 [Longevity Official]; his father was Liu Tianci 天賜; and his mother is née Gao 高. His mother is living. His elder brother is Liu Yigui 一桂 [Sacrificial Attendant], and his younger brothers are Liu Yijie 一杰 and Liu Yiying 一楹. He married a woman née Meng 孟. He placed seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐上達〔貫江西廣信府永豐縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字孔學，行七，年二十九，十一月十七日生〕。曾祖永源，祖旭〔壽官〕，父州，母李氏。嚴侍下。弟繼達。娶周氏。江西鄉試第三十一名，會試第二百九名。

translation_en:
Wang Yanchen 汪言臣 (registered in a military household of Chongqing Guard 重慶衛, Sichuan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Kezhong 可忠; tenth in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twenty-sixth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yinghong 應洪, his grandfather was Wang Rong 榮, his father was Wang Biao 𣵠 (Assistant Prefect), and his mother is Madam Xu 徐氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Wang Yanshi 言詩, Wang Yanbiao 言表, Wang Yanli 言禮, Wang Yance 言策, Wang Yanshu 言書, Wang Yanyi 言易, Wang Yanmo 言謨, Wang Yanshi 言諟, and Wang Yanxian 言憲; his younger brothers are Wang Yanxin 言信 and Wang Yanhui 言惠. He married Madam Zhou 周氏. He ranked 40th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 142nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ling Dengying 凌登瀛 (registered in a civilian household of Qiantang County 錢塘縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yuanxue 元學; second in seniority among his brothers; age thirty, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Ling En 恩, his grandfather is Ling Gui 桂 (posthumously or honorifically titled Gentleman for Fostering Virtue, Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), his father is Ling Li 立 (Prefect), and his mother is Madam Zhu 朱氏 (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Ling Dengming 登名 (Tribute Student), and his younger brothers are Ling Dengdi 登第 and Ling Dengjia 登嘉. He married Madam Wang 王氏. He ranked 1st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 29th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Shangda 徐上達 (registered in a military household of Yongfeng County 永豐縣, Guangxin Prefecture 廣信府, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents; courtesy name Kongxue 孔學; seventh in seniority among his brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yongyuan 永源, his grandfather was Xu Xu 旭 (Honorary Official for Longevity), his father is Xu Zhou 州, and his mother was Madam Li 李氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brother is Xu Jida 繼達. He married Madam Zhou 周氏. He ranked 31st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 209th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shoupu 張守朴 (registered in an official household of the Chengdu Left Escort Guard 成都左護衛, Sichuan, a native of Pi County 郫縣; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Yuanqing 元卿; first in seniority among his brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Han 漢, his grandfather was Zhang Jie 節, his father was Zhang Lan 蘭, and his mother was Madam Li 李氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Madam Shen 沈氏. He ranked 56th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 262nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐申〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字維嶽，行一，年三十，十月二十九日生〕。曾祖朴；祖燿〔贈刑部主事〕；父履和〔監生〕；母陳氏；繼母吳氏。慈侍下〔兄受〔監生〕、泰時〔貢士〕、時錫、九錫、師錫；弟永錫、敷錫、元卿、寵卿、晉錫〔俱監生〕、天錫、蕃錫。娶凌氏〕。應天府鄉試第十名，會試第九十五名。

何存斆〔貫四川成都府温江縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字念卿，行九，年二十九，三月初七日生〕。曾祖魁；祖永壽；父含；母金氏；繼母韓氏。永感下。兄存道、存蔭、存偉、存仁、存敬、存教、存義、存性；弟存徵、存微。娶劉氏。四川鄉試第十六名，會試第二百九十三名。
translation_en:
Cao Yipeng 曹一鵬, registered under a civilian household in Renqiu County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili, was a County Student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing), with the courtesy name Ziyun, second in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-six, and born on the tenth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Cao Zan; his grandfather was Cao Huai; his father is Cao Dong, a Sacrificial Attendant; his father's former wife was Lady Bian; and his mother is Lady Liu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Cao Zhen, Cao Can, Cao Xun, and Cao Yifeng; his younger brothers are Cao Yihe, Cao Yihu, Cao Yiji, and Cao Yizhi. He married Lady Liu. He placed 51st in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and 184th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yiyang 李一陽, registered in a petty military household of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard and a native of Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Zhili, was a Prefectural Student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing), with the courtesy name Changqing, fourth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, and born on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Li Shi, an Assistant Prefect; his grandfather is Li Guo, a Sacrificial Attendant; his father is Li Xiong; and his mother is Lady Qian. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Li Kun and Li Pei; his younger brothers are Li Yiben, Li Yide, Li Yiguan, Li Yijing, Li Yixin, and Li Yiyuan. He married Lady Tao. He placed 57th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and 236th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Shen 徐申, registered under a civilian household in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili, was a County Student specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing), with the courtesy name Weiyue, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty, and born on the twenty-ninth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Xu Pu; his grandfather was Xu Yao, posthumously honoured as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice; his father was Xu Lühe, a Directorate Student; his mother was Lady Chen; and his stepmother is Lady Wu. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Xu Shou (a Directorate Student), Xu Taishi (a tribute student [gongshi]), Xu Shixi, Xu Jiuxi, and Xu Shixi; his younger brothers are Xu Yongxi, Xu Fuxi, Xu Yuanqing, Xu Chongqing, and Xu Jinxi (all Directorate Students), as well as Xu Tianxi and Xu Fanxi. He married Lady Ling. He placed 10th in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and 95th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Cunxiao 何存斆, registered under a civilian household in Wenjiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), with the courtesy name Nianqing, ninth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, and born on the seventh day of the third month. His great-grandfather was He Kui; his grandfather was He Yongshou; his father was He Han; his mother was Lady Jin; and his stepmother was Lady Han. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are He Cundao, He Cunyin, He Cunwei, He Cunren, He Cunjing, He Cunjiao, He Cunyi, and He Cunxing; his younger brothers are He Cunzheng and He Cunwei. He married Lady Liu. He placed 16th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 293rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Ye 陳燁 (registered under civilian household status in Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Ziqian; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the fourteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Xi; his grandfather was Chen Tong; his father is Chen Shiying; his mother is Lady Xu. Both parents are living. His younger brother is Chen Zhuo. He married Lady Xu, and remarried Lady Zhu. He ranked fifteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xing Kongyang 邢孔陽 (registered under civilian household status in Wen'an County, Bazhou Department, Shuntian Prefecture; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Gongzhao; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the seventh day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Xing Lan (Assistant Instructor); his grandfather was Xing Shulun; his father is Xing Wanxiang; his mother is Lady Zhao. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xing Zhiwan, Xing Kongzhao, Xing Zhiqi, and Xing Kongming; his younger brothers are Xing Kongshi, Xing Kongyi, Xing Konghui, Xing Zhishu, and Xing Kongshuo. He married Lady Jiang. He ranked thirtieth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred seventy-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Duan 方端 (registered under civilian household status in Gushi County, Guangzhou Department, Runing Prefecture, Henan; a County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Chafu; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the intercalary ninth month). His great-grandfather was Fang Wan (District Magistrate, posthumously granted the title of Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue); his grandfather was Fang Zhong; his father is Fang Zhichong; his mother is Lady Xiong. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Fang Jing. He married Lady Yi. He ranked fifty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zizhong 張子忠 (registered under civilian household status in Jining Department, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Xianke; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Rui; his grandfather was Zhang Yan; his father is Zhang Wenchao (Honorary Official Held in Respect for His Age); his mother was Lady Zhu; his stepmother is Lady Xing. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brothers are Zhang Zishu, Zhang Zide, and Zhang Zique. He married Lady Zhu. He ranked twenty-ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shiyang 王世揚 [registered in a civilian household of Guangping County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; County School Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Xiaofu; second in his generation; age thirty; born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang You 友; his grandfather was Wang Chen 臣; his father was Wang Yunwu 允武 [Administrator (zhangshi) of a Princely Establishment]; his father's former wife was née Du 都, and his mother is née Zhao 趙. His mother is living. His elder brother is Wang Duiyang 對揚. He married née Ning 甯. He placed twenty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural Examination and three-hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Yangmeng 張養蒙 [registered in an artisan household of Zezhou, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Shuheng; second in his generation; age twenty-seven; born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Kuo 擴; his grandfather was Zhang Wen 穩; his father is Zhang Siwei 四維 [Confucian Official]; and his mother is née Xue 薛. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Qimeng 啓蒙. He married née Zhao 趙. He placed third in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Rao Xueshi 饒學詩 [registered in a civilian household of Dong'e County, Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, originally from Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Yanqing; first in his generation; age thirty-one; born on the eleventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Rao Jianzhe 儉哲; his grandfather was Rao Zhenfu 振福; his father is Rao Tingyun 停雲; and his mother is née Wu 吳. Both of his parents are living. He married née Gao 高. He placed seventieth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng Lian 鄧鍊 [registered in a military household of Nancheng County, Jianchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenchun; second in his generation; age twenty-six; born on the twenty-eighth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Deng Huai 槐; his grandfather was Deng Lu 祿; his father was Deng Weiyuan 維垣 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; and his mother is née Ning 甯. His mother is living. His elder brother is Deng E 鍔, and his younger brother is Deng Qiang 鏘. He married née Zhang 章. He placed sixty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Chen Yingxi 陳應煕 [registered in a civilian household of Ouning County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhongmu; first in his generation; aged thirty-three, born on the tenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Rui, his grandfather was Chen Jie, his father was Chen Qi, and his mother is Madam Cheng. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Yingxiu [Tribute Student], Yingjue, and Yingxu. He married Madam Xie. He ranked 24th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 93rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Cilü 丁此吕 [registered in a civilian household of Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Youwu; third in his generation; aged twenty-eight, born on the thirtieth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Ding Dazhang [posthumously honored through successive promotions as Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Minister of War in Nanjing], his grandfather is Ding Yizhong [Right Vice Minister of War in Nanjing, successively promoted to Grand Master for Assisting toward Good Governance], his father is Ding Yun, and his mother is Madam Zou. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Cizhou [Official Student], and his younger brothers are Cizhao, Cibi, Ciyuan, Ciliang, Cishen, Cishen, and Cimo. He married Madam Qiu. He ranked 68th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 27th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Mingfeng 楊鳴鳳 [registered in a civilian household of Ba County, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ziyi; first in his generation; aged thirty-four, born on the sixth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Wenfu, his grandfather was Yang Yinglin, his father was Yang Zao, and his mother was Madam Liu. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Madam Yi, and subsequently married Madam Liu and Madam Liu. He ranked 55th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 267th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bai Yiyan 白一言 [registered in a civilian household of Yongnian County, Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zishu; first in his generation; aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Bai Jin, his grandfather is Bai Ang, his father is Bai Qing [Assistant Instructor], and his mother is Madam Xie. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Zhengyan, Xunyan, and Wanyan. He married Madam Wen. He ranked 54th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 89th in the Metropolitan Examination.

孫瀾〔貫河南河南府洛陽縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子源，行二，年二十五，十二月十七日生〕。曾祖鑑；祖縉〔散官〕；父朴〔儒官〕；母徐氏。重慶下。兄濶；弟潤、澤。娶鄭氏。河南鄉試第四十名，會試第二百七十三名。

潘元和〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字節甫，行三，年三十，八月二十八日生〕。曾祖衡；祖員俊；父子秀；母張氏，生母唐氏。具慶下。兄舜元、元貞、元功、元善。娶諸氏。應天府鄉試第十一名，會試第四十名。
translation_en:
Zhan Shijiang 詹事講 (native of Le'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi, of commoner registration; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Mingfu; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-fourth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Zhan Zunxun (posthumously honoured as Prefectural Judge), his grandfather was Zhan Chong (Assistant Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud), his father was Zhan Zhou (Prefectural Instructor), his father's former wife was née Zou, his mother was née Yu, and his stepmother is née Ding. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Zhan Shiyan, Zhan Shi'e, and Zhan Shijian; his younger brothers are Zhan Shiqian and Zhan Shirang. He married née Zeng. He placed twelfth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Fengshun 賀逢舜 (native of Yiyang County, Changsha Prefecture, Huguang, of military registration; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yilong; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was He Cheng (Honorary Official Named for Longevity), his grandfather was He Xian (District Magistrate), his father is He Fengwu (Subprefectural Assistant Magistrate), and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is He Fengyao; his younger brothers are He Fengyu and He Fengzhou. He married née Tang. He placed forty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Lan 孫瀾 (native of Luoyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan, of commoner registration; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Ziyuan; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Jian, his grandfather is Sun Jin (Prestige Official), his father is Sun Pu (Confucian Official), and his mother is née Xu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Sun Kuo; his younger brothers are Sun Run and Sun Ze. He married née Zheng. He placed fortieth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Yuanhe 潘元和 (native of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], of commoner registration; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Jiefu; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty, born on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Pan Heng, his grandfather was Pan Yuanjun, his father is Pan Zixiu, his legal mother is née Zhang, and his birth mother is née Tang. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Pan Shunyuan, Pan Yuanzhen, Pan Yuangong, and Pan Yuanshan. He married née Zhu. He placed eleventh in the Yingtian Prefectural [Provincial] Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xie Zhiyi 謝志伊 (native of Shen Department, Zhending Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], of civilian registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Dagong, first in seniority; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Lun; his grandfather was Xie Shi; his father is Xie Ju; and his mother was Lady Zheng. His father is still living. He is married to Lady Shi. He placed 150th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 291st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Anguo 吳安國 (native of Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], of civilian registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Wenzhong, first in seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the fifth day of the intercalary ninth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Yipeng (Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Nanjing Minister of Personnel, posthumously promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and canonized as Wenduan); his grandfather was Wu Zixiao (Administration Vice Commissioner); his father is Wu Shangjian; and his mother is Lady Huangfu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wu Anren, Wu Anshi, Wu Anmin, Wu Anzhi, Wu Anshang, Wu Anjie, Wu Anshi, Wu Anzhong, and Wu Anli. He is married to Lady Wang. He placed 47th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 26th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Wenyao 張文耀 (native of Yuanling County, Chenzhou Prefecture, Huguang, of civilian registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yanghui, second in seniority; aged thirty-eight, born on the seventeenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Bilun; his grandfather was Zhang Jue; his father was Zhang Yiqing (Sacrificial Attendant); and his mother was Lady Wu. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Zhang Wenhuan, and his younger brother is Zhang Wenhuang. He is married to Lady Zhu. He placed 19th in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 235th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Fu 曹鈇 (native of Changqing County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, of military registration; National University Student, specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Minwei, fifth in seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the seventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Pan; his grandfather was Cao Gongzheng; his father was Cao Xian (Vice Magistrate); his principal mother was Lady Li, and his birth mother was Lady Zhang. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Cao Quan, Cao Rui, Cao Rong, and Cao Dun. He is married to Lady Zhang. He placed 34th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 228th in the Metropolitan Examination.

宋附〔貫四川成都府後衛官籍，江西南昌府豐城縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字仲翼，行五，年三十六，六月二十六日生〕。曾祖禎〔都指揮〕；祖文〔都指揮〕；父師顏，母孫氏，繼母彭氏。永感下。兄隆〔指揮〕、隱、隲；弟陪、陞、階。娶白氏。四川鄉試第三十名，會試第一百六十二名。
translation_en:
Liu Minkuan 劉敏寬 (registered under a civilian household in Anyi County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Bogong, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Fang; his grandfather was Liu Ze; his father was Liu Bangzhu, and his mother is née Shao. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Liu Dekuan (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner), Liu Liangkuan, Liu Fukuan (Department Magistrate), and Liu Zhenkuan (Tribute Student); his younger brothers are Liu Xingkuan, Liu Zhongkuan (Tribute Student), Liu Jikuan, Liu Yikuan, and Liu Xingkuan. He married née Zhang. He placed 2nd in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 78th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Guanguang 李觀光 (registered under a salt-producer household in Cangzhou, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Binzhi, first in seniority, aged thirty-four, born on the eighth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Li Kai; his grandfather was Li Pu (Vice Magistrate); his father was Li Kengou (Annual Tribute Student), and his mother is née Cheng. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Li Guanhua, Li Guanxiang, and Li Guancheng. He married née Cheng. He placed 114th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 233rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guan Yingfeng 管應鳳 (registered under a military household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Minghe, second in seniority, aged twenty-five, born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Guan Lin (posthumously honored as Supervising Secretary for the Office of Scrutiny for Personnel); his grandfather was Guan Jian (Right Administration Vice Commissioner); his father is Guan Fu (District Magistrate), and his mother is née Shao. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Guan Yingjue and Guan Yingzhao; his younger brothers are Guan Yinglin, Guan Ying'en, Guan Yingzhi, and Guan Yingchang. He married née Weng. He placed 66th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 219th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Fu 宋附 (registered under an official military household in the Rear Guard of Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, originally from Fengcheng County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhongyi, fifth in seniority, aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-sixth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Song Zhen (Regional Military Commissioner); his grandfather was Song Wen (Regional Military Commissioner); his father was Song Shiyan, his mother was née Sun, and his stepmother was née Peng. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Song Long (Guard Commander), Song Yin, and Song Zhi; his younger brothers are Song Pei, Song Sheng, and Song Jie. He married née Bai. He placed 30th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 162nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Sanwei 徐三畏 (registered in a civilian household in Renqiu County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili, and originally from Qiantang County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zijing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the third day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Xu Jin; his grandfather was Xu Yue; his father was Xu Haoyi; his mother was Lady Tian. Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Xu Sanren and Xu Sanhuai, and his younger brother is Xu Sancai. He married Lady Yang. He placed 9th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 111th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Guoxi 張國璽 (registered in a civilian household in Renqiu County, Hejian Prefecture, Zhili; a County School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Junxin; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the third day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Cong; his grandfather was Zhang Shen; his father is Zhang Bingheng; his mother is Lady Bu. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Guobi, and his younger brother is Zhang Guoying. He married Lady Sun. He placed 135th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 180th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jichun 李際春 (registered in a military officer household in the Qizhou Guard, Huguang; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Heyuan; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Li Jing (Battalion Commander); his grandfather was Li Zhen (Battalion Commander); his father was Li Ru (Battalion Commander); his mother is Lady Huang (invested as Lady of Suitability). His father is deceased and his mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Tongchun (Guard Commander), Li Dechun, Li Mengchun (Tribute Student), and Li Shengchun (Left Assistant Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission). He married Lady Fu. He placed 3rd in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 50th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Shizhen 孫世禎 (registered in a military officer household in the Qingping Guard, Guizhou, and originally from Andong County, Huai'an Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhengfu; tenth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Hong (Company Commander); his grandfather was Sun Bin (Company Commander); his father is Sun Jiwu (District Magistrate); his mother is Lady Ou. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Sun Shixiang (Company Commander), Sun Shiyang, Sun Shiji, and Sun Shiyu, and his younger brothers are Sun Shijue and Sun Shiyou. He married Lady Jiang. He placed 24th in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and 278th in the Metropolitan Examination.

白希繡〔貫陝西延安府膚施縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字惟錦，行二，年二十七，六月初五日生〕。曾祖釗；祖景鳴；父昇；母劉氏。永感下。兄希繪；弟希綵、希綺、希綬、希緯、希練、希綃。娶陳氏。陝西鄉試第二十六名，會試第二百二十三名。

秦可貞〔貫陝西西安府咸寧縣匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字季章，行三，年二十九，十二月十三日生〕。曾祖庠；祖福〔贈府同知〕；父登〔左長史，贈參議〕；前母解氏〔贈恭人〕；母賀氏〔封太恭人〕。永感下。兄可久〔府通判〕、可大〔行太僕寺卿〕；弟可觀。娶韓氏，繼娶曹氏、徐氏。陝西鄉試第六十二名，會試第二百二十九名。
translation_en:
Zhang Zhi 張志 [registered in a civilian household in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Yudao; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the third day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Xianhui; his grandfather was Zhang Ru [posthumously granted the title of Case Reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review]; his father is Zhang Lan [Right Administration Vice Commissioner]; his mother is Lady Cao. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Zhang Nian. He married Lady Yin, and subsequently married Lady Pan. He placed 14th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 101st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bai Xixiu 白希繡 [registered in a civilian household in Fushi County, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); style name Weijin; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the fifth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Bai Zhao; his grandfather was Bai Jingming; his father was Bai Sheng; his mother was Lady Liu. Both parents are deceased. His elder brother is Bai Xihui; his younger brothers are Bai Xicai, Bai Xiqi, Bai Xishou, Bai Xiwei, Bai Xilian, and Bai Xixiao. He married Lady Chen. He placed 26th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 223rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Chengyu 葉承遇 [registered in a saltern household in Yongjia County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Sizhang; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the twenty-first day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Ye Fan; his grandfather was Ye Wan; his father was Ye Xunxue; his mother was Lady Lin. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Ye Xuan [Royal Physician], Ye Chengsui, Ye Shu, and Ye Yue; his younger brother is Ye Chengying. He married Lady Wang. He placed 22nd in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 10th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qin Kezhen 秦可貞 [registered in an artisan household in Xianning County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Jizhang; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Qin Xiang; his grandfather was Qin Fu [posthumously granted the title of Prefectural Vice Prefect]; his father was Qin Deng [Left Administrator, posthumously granted the title of Administration Vice Commissioner]; his father's first wife was Lady Xie [posthumously granted the title of Revered Lady (gongren)]; his mother was Lady He [invested with the title of Dowager Revered Lady (tai gongren)]. Both parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Qin Kejiu [Prefectural Assistant Prefect] and Qin Keda [Chief Minister of the Branch Court of the Imperial Stud]; his younger brother is Qin Keguan. He married Lady Han, and subsequently married Lady Cao and Lady Xu. He placed 62nd in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 229th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
謝應典〔貫福建興化府莆田縣，軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字道揚，行一，年三十二，十二月二十三日生〕。曾祖肇脩，祖貴安，父成德，母鄭氏。永感下。弟應昌。娶徐氏，繼娶阮氏。順天府鄉試第十三名，會試第三十一名。

程達〔貫江西臨江府清江縣，匠籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字于順，行八，年三十三，閏正月十七日生〕。曾祖獎德，祖珍爵，父成譽〔教諭〕，前母劉氏，母傅氏，繼母錢氏。具慶下。兄途、遷、遂。娶黃氏。江西鄉試第七十二名，會試第二百七十一名。

董子行〔貫浙江紹興衛軍籍，紹興府嵊縣人，國子生。治《易經》，字明卿，行二，年二十八，正月十六日生〕。曾祖慶，祖勝，父和，母姜氏。慈侍下。娶何氏。浙江鄉試第九十名，會試第六十八名。

支應瑞〔貫江西南昌府進賢縣，民籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字汝賢，行四，年三十二，正月十二日生〕。曾祖王瓚，祖文富，父檜〔布政司經歷〕，母羅氏。永感下。娶徐氏。江西鄉試第六十八名，會試第二百二十五名。
translation_en:
Xie Yingdian 謝應典 (registered in Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian, under a military household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Daoyang 道揚; first in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-third day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Zhaoxiu 謝肇脩, his grandfather was Xie Gui'an 謝貴安, his father was Xie Chengde 謝成德, and his mother was Lady Zheng 鄭氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He has a younger brother, Xie Yingchang 謝應昌. He married Lady Xu 徐氏, and took Lady Ruan 阮氏 as his second wife. He placed thirteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Da 程達 (registered in Qingjiang County 清江縣, Linjiang Prefecture 臨江府, Jiangxi, under an artisan household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yushun 于順; eighth in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the seventeenth day of the intercalary first month). His great-grandfather was Cheng Jiangde 程獎德, his grandfather was Cheng Zhenjue 程珍爵, and his father is Cheng Chengyu 程成譽 (Confucian Instructor). His father's former wife was Lady Liu 劉氏, his birth mother was Lady Fu 傅氏, and his stepmother is Lady Qian 錢氏. His father and stepmother are both living. He has elder brothers Cheng Tu 程途, Cheng Qian 程遷, and Cheng Sui 程遂. He married Lady Huang 黃氏. He placed seventy-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Zixing 董子行 (registered under a military household in Shaoxing Guard 紹興衛, Zhejiang, a native of Sheng County 嵊縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mingqing 明卿; second in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Dong Qing 董慶, his grandfather was Dong Sheng 董勝, his father was Dong He 董和, and his mother is Lady Jiang 姜氏. His mother is living and his father is deceased. He married Lady He 何氏. He placed ninetieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhi Yingrui 支應瑞 (registered in Jinxian County 進賢縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi, under a civilian household; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Ruxian 汝賢; fourth in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twelfth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhi Wangzan 支王瓚 [?], his grandfather was Zhi Wenfu 支文富, his father was Zhi Gui 支檜 (Registrar of a Provincial Administration Commission), and his mother was Lady Luo 羅氏. Both of his parents are deceased. He married Lady Xu 徐氏. He placed sixty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and two hundred twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

楊東野〔貫山東青州府莒州沂水縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字啟明，行一，年三十，三月初五日生〕。曾祖光溥〔按察司副使，進階大中大夫〕；祖一元〔教諭〕；父世芳〔壽官〕；母相氏。嚴侍下。弟起野、朝野。娶劉氏，繼娶郭氏。山東鄉試第六十一名，會試第二百四十七名。

屠隆〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字長卿，行十四，年三十五，六月二十五日生〕。曾祖子雲；祖璞；父濬；母趙氏。慈侍下。兄俓、侯、俅、儦、仍。娶楊氏。浙江鄉試第九名，會試第一百三十二名。

范儁〔貫江西瑞州府高安縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字國士，行七，年三十三，三月初七日生〕。曾祖孔忠；祖曰相；父廷綱；母謝氏。具慶下。兄伋〔刑部郎中〕；弟偲、倣、岱、倬、佖。娶戴氏，繼娶劉氏、陳氏。江西鄉試第九十三名，會試第一百四十四名。
translation_en:
Yang Dongye 楊東野 [registered in a military household in Yishui County, Ju Subprefecture, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong; Directorate Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Qiming 啟明; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the fifth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Guangpu 光溥 [Surveillance Vice Commissioner, promoted in prestige title to Grand Master of Imperial Entertainments with Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon]; his grandfather was Yang Yiyuan 一元 [Instructor]; his father was Yang Shifang 世芳 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; and his mother was née Xiang 相. His father is living and his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Yang Qiye 起野 and Yang Chaoye 朝野. He married née Liu 劉, and remarried née Guo 郭. He placed 61st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 247th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Nanying 朱南英 [registered in a military household in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Book of Odes (Shijing); courtesy name Zichun 子醇; seventeenth in seniority among his male cousins/brothers; aged thirty, born on the third day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhu Luan 鑾; his grandfather was Zhu Shangwen 尚文; his father was Zhu Dongyang 東陽 [invested with the title of Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Justice]; and his mother was née Liu 劉 [invested as Child Nurturer]. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhu Nanyong 南雍 [Vice Prefect]; his younger brothers are Zhu Nanjin 南金 [Directorate Student (jiansheng)], Zhu Nanpeng 南鵬, and Zhu Nanji 南箕. He married née Huang 黃. He placed 74th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 63rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Long 屠隆 [registered in a civilian household in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; Supernumerary Student of the County School; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Changqing 長卿; fourteenth in seniority among his male cousins/brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-fifth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Tu Ziyun 子雲; his grandfather was Tu Pu 璞; his father was Tu Jun 濬; and his mother was née Zhao 趙. His mother is living and his father is deceased. His elder brothers are Tu Jing 俓, Tu Hou 侯, Tu Qiu 俅, Tu Biao 儦, and Tu Reng 仍. He married née Yang 楊. He placed 9th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fan Jun 范儁 [registered in a civilian household in Gao'an County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; Directorate Student; specialized in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Guoshi 國士; seventh in seniority among his male cousins/brothers; aged thirty-three, born on the seventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Fan Kongzhong 孔忠; his grandfather was Fan Yuexiang 曰相; his father was Fan Tinggang 廷綱; and his mother was née Xie 謝. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Fan Ji 伋 [Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice]; his younger brothers are Fan Si 偲, Fan Fang 倣, Fan Dai 岱, Fan Zhuo 倬, and Fan Bi 佖. He married née Dai 戴, and remarried née Liu 劉 and née Chen 陳. He placed 93rd in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 144th in the Metropolitan Examination.

傅光宅〔貫山東東昌府聊城縣，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字伯安，行七，年二十八，四月二十日生〕。曾祖璋〔敎諭〕；祖相〔知縣〕；父學易〔貢士〕；母汪氏。具慶下。兄光宇、光祖、光霽、光宙、光先、光庭；弟光啓、光熈、光和。娶耿氏，繼娶烏氏、冀氏。山東鄉試第九名，會試第二十二名。

黃學會〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣，民籍，府學增廣生，治《易經》，字唯吾，行一，年三十三，七月二十四日生〕。曾祖惟眞〔義官〕；祖廷舉；父夢吉；母吳氏。慈侍下。弟學韶、學孟。娶孔氏。廣東鄉試第四十五名，會試第一百五十五名。

王國〔貫陝西西安府耀州，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字之楨，行一，年二十七，十二月初八日生〕。曾祖永寧〔陰陽官〕；祖宗仁〔壽官〕；父邦憲〔府通判〕；嫡母雷氏、左氏，生母党氏。重慶下。弟田、圖〔貢士〕、鞏。娶辛氏。陝西鄉試第三十八名，會試第四十二名。

translation_en:
Fu Guangzhai 傅光宅 (registered in Liaocheng County 聊城縣, Dongchang Prefecture 東昌府, Shandong 山東, under military status; a student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy [Guozisheng 國子生] specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing 詩經]; courtesy name Bo'an 伯安, seventh in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-eight sui, born on the twentieth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Fu Zhang 傅璋 (Instructor [Jiaoyu 敎諭]); his grandfather was Fu Xiang 傅相 (District Magistrate [Zhixian 知縣]); his father is Fu Xueyi 傅學易 (Tribute Student [Gongshi 貢士]); and his mother is Lady Wang 汪氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Guangyu 光宇, Guangzu 光祖, Guangji 光霽, Guangzhou 光宙, Guangxian 光先, and Guangting 光庭; his younger brothers are Guangqi 光啓, Guangxi 光熈, and Guanghe 光和. He married Lady Geng 耿氏, and subsequently married Lady Wu 烏氏 and Lady Ji 冀氏. He placed ninth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Xuehui 黃學會 (registered in Nanhai County 南海縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東, under civilian status; an Added Student of a Prefectural School [Fuxue zengguangsheng 府學增廣生] specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing 易經]; courtesy name Weiwu 唯吾, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three sui, born on the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Huang Weizhen 黃惟眞 (Righteous Official [Yiguan 義官]); his grandfather was Huang Tingju 黃廷舉; his father was Huang Mengji 黃夢吉; and his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Xueshao 學韶 and Xuemeng 學孟. He married Lady Kong 孔氏. He placed forty-fifth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Guo 王國 (registered in Yaozhou 耀州, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi 陝西, under military status; a student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Zhizhen 之楨, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven sui, born on the eighth day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Yongning 王永寧 (Yin-yang Official [Yinyangguan 陰陽官]); his grandfather is Wang Zongren 王宗仁 (Longevity Official [Shouguan 壽官]); his father is Wang Bangxian 王邦憲 (Prefectural Assistant Prefect [Fu tongpan 府通判]); his legal mothers were Lady Lei 雷氏 and Lady Zuo 左氏, and his birth mother is Lady Dang 党氏. Both grandparents and parents are living. His younger brothers are Tian 田, Tu 圖 (Tribute Student), and Gong 鞏. He married Lady Xin 辛氏. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gu Yuncheng 顧雲程 (registered in Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸], under civilian status; a student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy specializing in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Wuyuan 務遠, fifth in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one sui, born on the eighth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Gu Xian 顧賢; his grandfather was Gu Jiang 顧江; his father was Gu Zao 顧早; his father's former wives were Lady Wang 王氏 and Lady Su 蘇氏, and his mother is Lady Lu 陸氏. His mother is living. He married Lady Zhou 周氏. He placed twenty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural [Nanjing] Provincial Examination and eighty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.
