translation_en:
Huo Peng 霍鵬 [registered in Jingxing County, Zhending Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under a military household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuncheng; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight; born on the second day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Huo Chaoyong (Granary Commissioner-in-chief), his grandfather was Huo Dai, his father is Huo Meizhi, and his mother is Lady Li. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Huo He, Huo Lu, and Huo Kun. He married Lady Li, and remarried Lady Kang. He placed 64th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 88th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yingxiang 李應祥 [registered in Wuxi County, Changzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), under a military household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shanzheng; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight; born on the eighth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Jun, his grandfather was Li Wang (Instructor), his father was Li Hui, and his mother is Lady Yang. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Qixiang and Li Zhaoxiang, and his younger brother is Li Chengxiang. He married Lady Mao. He placed 52nd in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 75th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Shufang 屠叔方 [registered in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, native of Pinghu County; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Zongzhi; fourth in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three; born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Tu Ji (posthumously honored as Minister of Justice), his grandfather was Tu Xun (Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of Justice, posthumously honored as Junior Guardian and canonized as Kangxi), his father was Tu Yingjun (Admonisher of the Right Secretariat of the Heir Apparent concurrently serving as Academician Reader-in-waiting of the Hanlin Academy), and his mother is Lady Xiang (invested as Lady of Suitability). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Tu Mengxuan (invested as Secretary in the Ministry of Justice), Tu Zhonglü (Prefect), and Tu Zhongxing (Directorate Student), and his younger brother is Tu Shuzhang (Directorate Student). He married Lady Zhao. He placed 21st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 263rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Liang 王亮 [registered in Linhai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under a civilian household; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Maoda; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two; born on the twenty-second day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Yuan (posthumously honored as Grand Master for Fostering Uprightness and Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice), his grandfather was Wang Du (Prefect), his father is Wang Yindong (Assistant Instructor), and his mother was Lady Dai. His father is living. His younger brothers are Wang Gao and Wang Hao. He married Lady Dai. He placed 21st in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 84th in the Metropolitan Examination.

朱維藩〔貫直隸淮安衛中左所官籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字价卿，行一，年三十四，十一月十三日生〕。曾祖鐘〔千戶，封武略將軍〕；祖濟〔贈武略將軍〕；父鸞〔進階指揮僉事〕；母王氏〔封宜人〕；繼母謝氏。具慶下。弟維垣〔指揮僉事〕、維屏、維翰、維城、維德、維慶。娶蔣氏。應天府鄉試第三十名，會試第一百二十名。

陳禹謨〔貫浙江杭州府仁和縣匠籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字孟文，行一，年三十六，六月十九日生〕。曾祖琬；祖景祥〔贈知府〕；父洪濛〔都察院右副都御史〕；母韓氏〔封恭人〕。具慶下。弟皐謨、益謨、夔謨、契謨、伊謨。娶李氏，繼娶張氏。浙江鄉試第十七名，會試第一百九十一名。

孫瑋〔貫陝西西安府渭南縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字純玉，行四，年二十五，十月初九日生〕。曾祖景陽〔贈府尹〕；祖爵〔贈府尹〕；父一誠〔指揮〕；母趙氏。具慶下。兄瓖〔監生〕、珙；弟璉、璵、瑍、琡、玻。娶姜氏，繼娶耿氏。陝西鄉試第三十一名，會試第二百七名。
translation_en:
Zhu Weifan 朱維藩 (registered in an official household of the Left-Center Battalion of Huai'an Guard in the Southern Metropolitan Area; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jiaqing 价卿; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Zhong 鐘 (Battalion Commander, ennobled as General of Military Strategy); his grandfather was Zhu Ji 濟 (posthumously honoured as General of Military Strategy); his father is Zhu Luan 鸞 (advanced in rank to Assistant Guard Commander); his mother was Lady Wang 王氏 (ennobled as Lady of Suitability); and his stepmother is Lady Xie 謝氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Weiyuan 維垣 (Assistant Guard Commander), Weiping 維屏, Weihan 維翰, Weicheng 維城, Weide 維德, and Weiqing 維慶. He married Lady Jiang 蔣氏. He placed 30th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 120th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Shike 張世科 (registered in a military household of Linyi County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Jimei 濟美; first in seniority; aged thirty-three, born on the fourteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Kui 奎; his grandfather was Zhang Siyi 思義; his father was Zhang Su 宿; and his mother was Lady Li 李氏. Both parents are deceased. He married Lady Li 李氏. He placed 12th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 182nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yumo 陳禹謨 (registered in an artisan household of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Mengwen 孟文; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Wan 琬; his grandfather was Chen Jingxiang 景祥 (posthumously honoured as Prefect); his father is Chen Hongmeng 洪濛 (Right Vice Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate); and his mother is Lady Han 韓氏 (ennobled as Lady of Respectability). Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Gaomo 皐謨, Yimo 益謨, Kuimo 夔謨, Ximo 契謨, and Yimo 伊謨. He married Lady Li 李氏, and later married Lady Zhang 張氏. He placed 17th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 191st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Wei 孫瑋 (registered in a military household of Weinan County, Xi'an Prefecture, Shaanxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Chunyu 純玉; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the ninth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Sun Jingyang 景陽 (posthumously honoured as Prefectural Governor); his grandfather was Sun Jue 爵 (posthumously honoured as Prefectural Governor); his father is Sun Yicheng 一誠 (Guard Commander); and his mother is Lady Zhao 趙氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xiang 瓖 (National University Student) and Gong 珙; his younger brothers are Lian 璉, Yu 璵, Huan 瑍, Shu 琡, and Bo 玻. He married Lady Jiang 姜氏, and later married Lady Geng 耿氏. He placed 31st in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 207th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
楊有仁〔貫四川成都府新都縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字以義，行五，年三十四，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖春〔提學僉事，累贈特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、華蓋殿大學士〕；祖廷和〔特進光祿大夫、左柱國、少師兼太子太師、吏部尚書、華蓋殿大學士，贈太保，諡文忠〕；父惇〔兵部主事〕；嫡母歐氏；生母辜氏。慈侍下。兄志仁〔都司經歷〕、其仁〔前府經歷〕、寧仁、斯仁；弟興仁〔指揮同知〕、右仁、資仁、力仁。娶嚴氏。四川鄉試第十名，會試第二百六十二名。

李驥千〔貫山東登州府招遠縣匠籍，國子生，治《書經》，字伯顧，行一，年三十二，五月二十九日生〕。曾祖月；祖仲春〔王府奉祠〕；父棟〔典史〕；母溫氏；繼母徐氏。具慶下。弟驥騄、驥良、驥驤、驥驂、驥服。娶閻氏，繼娶邵氏。山東鄉試第二十七名，會試第二百六十六名。

李洙〔貫山西太原府永寧州寧鄉縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字源魯，行五，年三十六，四月二十七日生〕。曾祖永；祖宗道〔州判〕；父士輝〔主簿〕；母吳氏。慈侍下。兄瀛〔主簿〕、淅、洛、洵。娶衛氏。山西鄉試第四十九名，會試第二百六十八名。

陳泰來〔貫浙江嘉興府平湖縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《易經》，字上交，行二，年十九，十月二十七日生〕。曾祖諫；祖善道〔府同知〕；父二典；母王氏。重慶下。兄晉明；弟豐亨、履慶、謙光。聘沈氏。浙江鄉試第六十九名，會試第三十五名。
translation_en:
Yang Youren 楊有仁 [registered in a commoner household of Xindu County 新都縣, Chengdu Prefecture 成都府, Sichuan; a County Student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yiyi 以義; fifth in generational seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Chun 楊春 [Education Intendant Assistant Surveillance Commissioner, cumulatively granted the posthumous prestige titles Specially Promoted Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Left Pillar of State, and the offices of Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall]; his grandfather was Yang Tinghe 楊廷和 [Specially Promoted Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Left Pillar of State, Junior Preceptor concurrently Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Minister of Personnel, and Grand Secretary of the Huagai Hall, posthumously granted the title of Grand Guardian and the canonization name Wenzhong 文忠]; his father was Yang Dun 楊惇 [Secretary in the Ministry of War]; his principal mother was Lady Ou 歐氏, and his birth mother is Lady Gu 辜氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Yang Zhiren 楊志仁 [Registrar of a Regional Military Commission], Yang Qiren 楊其仁 [formerly a Prefectural Registrar], Yang Ningren 楊寧仁, and Yang Siren 楊斯仁; his younger brothers are Yang Xingren 楊興仁 [Vice Commander], Yang Youren 楊右仁, Yang Ziren 楊資仁, and Yang Liren 楊力仁. He married Lady Yan 嚴氏. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jiqian 李驥千 [registered in an artisan household of Zhaoyuan County 招遠縣, Dengzhou Prefecture 登州府, Shandong; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Bogu 伯顧; first in generational seniority; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yue 李月; his grandfather was Li Zhongchun 李仲春 [Sacrificer in a Princely Establishment]; his father is Li Dong 李棟 [Unranked Subofficial (dianshi)]; his mother was Lady Wen 溫氏, and his stepmother is Lady Xu 徐氏. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Li Jilu 李驥騄, Li Jiliang 李驥良, Li Jixiang 李驥驤, Li Jican 李驥驂, and Li Jifu 李驥服. He married Lady Yan 閻氏, and subsequently married Lady Shao 邵氏. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zhu 李洙 [registered in a commoner household of Ningxiang County 寧鄉縣, Yongning Subprefecture 永寧州, Taiyuan Prefecture 太原府, Shanxi; a Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanlu 源魯; fifth in generational seniority; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yong 李永; his grandfather was Li Zongdao 李宗道 [Assistant Subprefect]; his father was Li Shihui 李士輝 [Assistant Magistrate]; his mother is Lady Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Li Ying 李瀛 [Assistant Magistrate], Li Xi 李淅, Li Luo 李洛, and Li Xun 李洵. He married Lady Wei 衛氏. He placed forty-ninth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Tailai 陳泰來 [registered in a commoner household of Pinghu County 平湖縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang; a Supernumerary County Student (xianxue fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Shangjiao 上交; second in generational seniority; aged nineteen, born on the twenty-seventh day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Jian 陳諫; his grandfather is Chen Shandao 陳善道 [Vice Prefect]; his father is Chen Erdian 陳二典; his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Chen Jinming 陳晉明; his younger brothers are Chen Fengheng 陳豐亨, Chen Lüqing 陳履慶, and Chen Qianguang 陳謙光. He is betrothed to Lady Shen 沈氏. He placed sixty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

丘度〔貫直隸淮安衛軍籍，山陽縣人，縣學生，治《禮記》，字汝洪，行二，年三十五，九月二十日生〕。曾祖斆，祖璪，父嵐，母沈氏。嚴侍下。兄應，弟康。娶王氏，繼娶楊氏。應天府鄉試第二十四名，會試第二百四十一名。
鄒元標〔貫江西吉安府吉水縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字爾瞻，行九，年二十七，八月二十七日生〕。曾祖純傑，祖廷俸，父潮，母羅氏。慈侍下。兄元梅、元楫，弟元柱、元杞、元梯、元楹、元校。娶歐陽氏，繼娶吳氏。江西鄉試第五十六名，會試第五十三名。
沈存仁〔貫貴州普安衛軍籍，直隸揚州府高郵州人，湖廣廣濟縣學教諭，治《易經》，字愛甫，行一，年三十二，正月十六日生〕。曾祖永華〔贈奉政大夫〕，祖尚綸，父洙，母陳氏。慈侍下。娶唐氏。貴州鄉試第七名，會試第二百八十一名。
沈自邠〔貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣民籍，嘉善縣人，國子生，治《書經》，字茂仁，行一，年二十四，四月十五日生〕。曾祖復〔封刑科給事中〕，祖謐〔布政司右參議，贈朝議大夫〕，父啟原〔按察司副使〕，母錢氏〔封安人〕。具慶下。弟自郇、自鄘。娶王氏。浙江鄉試第三十二名，會試第八名。
translation_en:
Qiu Du 丘度 (registered in a military household of Huai'an Guard in Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], a native of Shanyang County; a County Student specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Ruhong, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twentieth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Qiu Xiao, his grandfather was Qiu Zao, his father is Qiu Lan, and his mother was née Shen. His father is living. He has an elder brother, Qiu Ying, and a younger brother, Qiu Kang. He married née Wang, and remarried née Yang. He placed twenty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zou Yuanbiao 鄒元標 (registered in a civilian household of Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Erzhan, ninth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Zou Chunjie, his grandfather was Zou Tingfeng, his father was Zou Chao, and his mother is née Luo. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Zou Yuanmei and Zou Yuanji, and younger brothers Zou Yuanzhu, Zou Yuanqi, Zou Yuanti, Zou Yuanying, and Zou Yuanjiao. He married née Ouyang, and remarried née Wu. He placed fifty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Cunren 沈存仁 (registered in a military household of Pu'an Guard, Guizhou, originally from Gaoyou Subprefecture, Yangzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; an Instructor in the Confucian School of Guangji County, Huguang, specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Aifu, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Shen Yonghua (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Governance), his grandfather was Shen Shanglun, his father was Shen Zhu, and his mother is née Chen. His mother is living. He married née Tang. He placed seventh in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Zibin 沈自邠 (registered in a civilian household of Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, a native of Jiashan County; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Maoren, first in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Shen Fu (invested with the title of Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Justice), his grandfather was Shen Mi (Right Assistant Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission, posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Discussion), his father is Shen Qiyuan (Surveillance Vice Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission), and his mother is née Qian (invested as Mistress of Peace). Both of his parents are living. He has younger brothers Shen Zixun and Shen Ziyong. He married née Wang. He placed thirty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Hu Zaidao 胡載道 [registered under the Wanquan Regional Military Commission, originally from Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenfu 文甫; first in seniority; age thirty-three, born on the thirteenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Hu Qing 清; his grandfather was Hu Xuan 瑄; his father was Hu Kai 鎧; his mother was née Wang 王, and his stepmother was née Liu 劉. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Zaishao 載旆 and Zaixin 載信. He married née Chang 常, and remarried née Zhu 朱. He placed 2nd in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 297th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Shibin 吳世賓 [military registration in Hengshui County, Zhending Prefecture, Metropolitan Area (Zhili); National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Rujia 汝嘉; third in seniority; age thirty-three, born on the first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Heng 亨; his grandfather was Wu Xiu 秀; his father is Wu Tong 桐; his mother was née Zhao 趙. His father is living. His elder brothers are Shihuan 世宦 and Shiguan 世官, and his younger brothers are Shijia 世家 and Shi'an 世安. He married née Liu 劉, and remarried née Zhang 張. He placed 120th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 173rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yizhu 陳一洙 [military registration in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Guohuang 國潢; first in seniority; age twenty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Maozhao 懋昭; his grandfather was Chen Shu 恕 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his father is Chen Quan 銓; his mother is née Liu 劉. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Yimu 一沐, Yipei 一沛, Yilai 一淶, and Yixian 一涀. He married née Liu 劉. He placed 16th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 72nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hou Yingzheng 侯應徵 [commoner registration in Qi County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Gongxuan 公選; first in seniority; age thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Hou Xi 璽 [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his grandfather was Hou Jun 鈞 [Sacrificial Attendant]; his father was Hou Yiwei 一位; his mother was née Yuan 原, and his stepmother was née He 何. Both parents are deceased. His younger brothers are Yingping 應聘, Yingke 應科, and Yinggao 應誥. He married née Zhang 張. He placed 16th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 240th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Sance 陳三策 [registered as a civilian householder of Wuding Subprefecture in Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Youxue; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-seventh day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Qian (Instructor); his grandfather was Chen Tianxu (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father was Chen Du (Instructor); and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Sanbiao and Sangang. He married née Liu, and subsequently married née Zhang. He placed thirteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and ninetieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Hongchun 盧洪春 [registered as a civilian householder of Dongyang County in Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang, and a native of Zhuo Subprefecture in Shuntian Prefecture; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Siren; eighth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the sixteenth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Lian; his grandfather was Lu Yaomo (posthumously honoured as Grand Master for Comprehensive Duty and Vice Director in the Ministry of War); his father is Lu Zhongdian (Surveillance Commissioner of a Surveillance Commission); and his mother is née Hu (invested as Lady of Suitability). Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Hongxia (Tribute Student / gongshi), Hongqiu (Battalion Commander), Hongdong (Student of the Directorate of Education), and Hongrun. He married née Yu, and subsequently married née Ji. He placed one hundred and twenty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yuan 王元 [registered in a military household of Ningxia Guard, Shaanxi; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Shudiao; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the seventh day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Xuan; his grandfather was Wang Rui; his father was Wang Daxun; and his mother is née Liu. His mother is living. His elder brother is Xuezi. He married née Chen. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Du 李杜 [registered as a civilian householder of Feixiang County in Guangping Prefecture, Zhili; a student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hanqing; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zi; his grandfather was Li Ze; his father was Li Dian; his mother was née Shi, and his stepmother is née Hou. His stepmother is living. His elder brother is Song. He married née Wang, and subsequently married another née Wang. He placed thirty-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

陳璨〔貫山西澤州高平縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字子光，行二，年三十四，十一月二十二日生〕。曾祖智；祖銀；父忠，母龐氏，繼母何氏。永感下。兄瑚，弟珠、瑞。娶李氏，繼娶牛氏。山西鄉試第二十四名，會試第二百三十九名。

何懋官〔貫浙江温州府永嘉縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字希賢，行一，年二十六，九月二十九日生〕。曾祖麒；祖臯；父珂，母王氏。重慶下。兄懋誠，弟懋訓、懋賞、懋宣、懋宗、懋賓。娶張氏。浙江鄉試第四十六名，會試第一百四十名。

盧學禮〔貫直隸大名府東明縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字立甫，行一，年三十五，五月二十六日生〕。曾祖欽；祖澄〔壽官〕；父九錫，母蔡氏，繼母盛氏。嚴侍下。弟學樂、學射、學御。娶邢氏。順天府鄉試第七十六名，會試第二百七十九名。
translation_en:
Chen Can 陳璨 [registered in a civilian household of Gaoping County 高平縣, Zezhou 澤州, Shanxi 山西; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Ziguang 子光; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-four, born on the twenty-second day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Zhi 陳智; his grandfather was Chen Yin 陳銀; his father was Chen Zhong 陳忠, his mother was Madam Pang 龐氏, and his stepmother was Madam He 何氏. Both parents are deceased. He has an elder brother Chen Hu 陳瑚, and younger brothers Chen Zhu 陳珠 and Chen Rui 陳瑞. He married Madam Li 李氏, and remarried Madam Niu 牛氏. He placed twenty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Xianfang 李先芳 [registered in an agent household of the Embroidered-uniform Guard (Jinyiwei), a native of Penglai County 蓬萊縣, Dengzhou Prefecture 登州府, Shandong 山東; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Ziming 子明; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Zhong 李忠; his grandfather was Li Jing 李景; his father is Li Jie 李傑, and his mother is Madam Wu 吳氏. Both parents are living. He has an elder brother Li Xianmao 李先茂, and younger brothers Li Xianyin 李先蔭, Li Xianjin 李先藎, and Li Xianyi 李先藝. He married Madam Yang 楊氏, and remarried Madam Zhao 趙氏. He placed sixteenth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Maoguan 何懋官 [registered in a civilian household of Yongjia County 永嘉縣, Wenzhou Prefecture 温州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Supernumerary Government Student (fuxuesheng) of the County School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Xixian 希賢; first in seniority among his branch's brothers; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was He Qi 何麒; his grandfather is He Gao 何臯; his father is He Ke 何珂, and his mother is Madam Wang 王氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. He has an elder brother (cousin) He Maocheng 何懋誠, and younger brothers He Maoxun 何懋訓, He Maoshang 何懋賞, He Maoxuan 何懋宣, He Maozong 何懋宗, and He Maobin 何懋賓. He married Madam Zhang 張氏. He placed forty-sixth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Xueli 盧學禮 [registered in a civilian household of Dongming County 東明縣, Daming Prefecture 大名府, Zhili 直隸; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Lifu 立甫; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Lu Qin 盧欽; his grandfather was Lu Cheng 盧澄 [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father is Lu Jiuxi 盧九錫, his mother was Madam Cai 蔡氏, and his stepmother was Madam Sheng 盛氏. His father is living and his mother is deceased. He has younger brothers Lu Xueyue 盧學樂, Lu Xueshe 盧學射, and Lu Xueyu 盧學御. He married Madam Xing 邢氏. He placed seventy-sixth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Ma Chaoyang 馬朝陽 (registered in a civilian household of Taiyuan County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Fengming; first in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the thirtieth day of the eleventh month). His great-grandfather was Ma Huan, his grandfather was Ma Yingxian, his father was Ma Kui, and his mother was née Zhao. Both parents are living (juqing xia). He married née Yan. He placed 31st in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 174th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Qiyuan 楊起元 (registered in a military household of Linfen County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tiren; third in his generation; age twenty-seven, born on the second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Yang Sheng, his grandfather was Yang Cong (Honorary Elder, shouguan), his father was Yang Liu (Confucian Official, ruguan), and his mother was née Liang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Shiyuan and Yang Yingyuan, and his younger brothers are Yang Shaoyuan and Yang Tongyuan. He married née Lü. He placed 18th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 286th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Yingxuan 李應選 (registered in a civilian household of Zhaocheng County, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zideng; first in his generation; age twenty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Li Jing, his grandfather was Li Jie, his father was Li Chunguang (Confucian Official, ruguan), his mother was née Jia, and his stepmother was née Wei. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His younger brother is Li Yingxiang. He married née Ren and remarried née Tian. He placed 18th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 147th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pu Qing 浦卿 (registered in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyiwei), a native of Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Liangbi; third in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Pu Yu, his grandfather was Pu Jie, his father was Pu Ang, his mother was née Xu, and his stepmother was née Sun. His stepmother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Pu Zhao and Pu Xiang. He married née Kang and remarried née Zhang. He placed 129th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Li Zhi 李贄, courtesy name Zizhi 子執, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month, was registered in a civilian household of Xin'an County 新安縣, Henan Prefecture 河南府, Henan 河南, and was a Directorate Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Li Fu 福; his grandfather was Li Jin 進; his father is Li Yi 義, an Instructor (jiaoyu); and his mother was née Song 宋氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Li Bi 賁, a Tribute Student (gongshi), and his younger brothers are Li Geng 賡 and Li Shi 實. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed seventy-ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and one hundred seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Shengyu 馮生虞, courtesy name Deqing 德卿, sixth in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fifth month, was registered in a civilian household of Dazu County 大足縣, Chongqing Prefecture 重慶府, Sichuan 四川, and was a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Odes (Shijing). His great-grandfather was Feng Zhongkui 仲魁; his grandfather was Feng Chaozong 朝宗; his father is Feng Cong 驄, an Annual Tribute Student (suigongsheng); and his mother is née Xia 夏氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Feng Shengyu 盛虞, Feng Mingyu 名虞, Feng Shaoyu 紹虞, Feng Gengyu 賡虞 (a Tribute Student), and Feng Guanyu 官虞; his younger brothers are Feng Chenyu 臣虞, Feng Yiyu 益虞, Feng Piyu 闢虞, Feng Dengyu 登虞, Feng Xiyu 希虞, and Feng Binyu 賓虞. He married née Li 李氏. He placed sixty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Mengdou 沈夢斗, courtesy name Yingsu 應宿, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month, was registered in a civilian household of Jiashan County 嘉善縣, Jiaxing Prefecture 嘉興府, Zhejiang 浙江, and was a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His great-grandfather was Shen Ang 昂; his grandfather was Shen Han 翰; his father is Shen Cunde 存德; and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shen Mengsheng 夢昇, Shen Mengyin 夢印, Shen Mengqi 夢旂, and Shen Mengjie 夢節. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed sixtieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Jie 金節, courtesy name Chifu 持甫, second in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the second month, was registered in an official household of Nanhai County 南海縣, Guangzhou Prefecture 廣州府, Guangdong 廣東, and was a Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Jin Zan 瓚; his grandfather was Jin Feng 鳳; his father is Jin Zhao 詔; and his mother was née Xie 謝氏. His father is living. His elder brother is Jin Fan 範, and his younger brothers are Jin Jian 簡, Jin Ce 策, and Jin Ji 籍. He married née Li 李氏. He placed second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Yaochen 張堯臣, registered under civilian status in Neijiang County, Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan, was an Expectant Student in the county school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name was Xikui, he was first in his generational line, and he was twenty-seven years old, born on the third day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Zhang Hui; his grandfather was Zhang Shiyan, a Prefectural Vice Prefect; his father was Zhang Jie; and his mother was née Liu. Both his parents were deceased. His younger brothers were Shunchen, Jinchen, Liangchen, Wenchen, Wuchen, Tangchen, Yuanchen, and Zuochen, and he was married to née Liu. He placed 63rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 275th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jia Xiyi 賈希夷, registered under civilian status in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name was Ziqing, he was first in his generational line, and he was thirty-five years old, born on the twenty-second day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Jia Xing; his grandfather was Jia Ming; his father was Jia Zhixue; and his mother was née Liu. His mother was living and his father deceased. His younger brothers were Xiyin, Xihui, and Xizhou; he was married to née Song and remarried to née Li. He placed 26th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 221st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Guozhen 傅國珍, registered under civilian status in Jianyang County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian, was a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing). His courtesy name was Junpin, he was fourth in his generational line, and he was twenty-nine years old, born on the twenty-third day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Fu Fuxiang; his grandfather was Fu Han; his father was Fu Mei; and his mother was née Yu. Both his parents were living. His elder brothers were Guojing and Guoqing, his younger brother was Guochen, and he was married to née Xu. He placed 59th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 152nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Bi 陳璧, a native of Fuqing County registered under civilian status in Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, was a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name was Daoliang, he was sixth in his generational line, and he was twenty-seven years old, born on the fifth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Chen Mo; his grandfather was Chen Depu; his father was Chen Yanfu; and his mother was née Weng. Both his parents were living. His elder brothers were Daolu, Zisheng, and Zixiu; his younger brothers were Zicai, Zixu, and Ying; and he was married to née Huang. He placed 24th in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 69th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Sanzhong 徐三重 (native of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, South Zhili, of civilian registration; supplementary student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Botong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Xu Kui; his grandfather was Xu Shou; his father is Xu Pei; his mother is Lady Dai. Both his parents are living. His younger brother is San'de. He married Lady Gao. He placed thirty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zhiyou 王之猷 (native of Xincheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, of artisan registration; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry; courtesy name Erjia; fifth in seniority; aged twenty-nine, born on the second day of the twelfth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Wu; his grandfather was Wang Lin (Prefectural Instructor, posthumously titled Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue); his father was Wang Chongguang (Left Assistant Administration Commissioner, successively posthumously titled Chief Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial); his mother is Lady Liu (successively invested as Grand Mistress of Respect). His mother is living. His elder brothers are Zhihan (student of the Directorate of Education, invested as Director in the Ministry of Rites), Zhiyuan (Prefectural Governor), Zhifu (Department Magistrate), and Zhicheng (Selected Tribute Student); his younger brother is Zhidong. He married Lady Li. He placed sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Qi 劉綺 (native of Mianyang Department, Chengtian Prefecture, Huguang, of military registration; student of the Department School; specialized in the Classic of History; courtesy name Wenxian; third in seniority; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Liu Jingyang (Assistant Instructor); his grandfather is Liu Menglin (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father is Liu Yan (Administrative Clerk); his legal mothers were Lady Wang and Lady Wu, and his birth mother is Lady Wang. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Wei and Ying; his younger brothers are Cai, Zuan, Chun, Zi, Zong, Shou, and Ji. He married Lady Li. He placed forty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Wei 曹煒 (native of Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, of civilian registration; student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes; courtesy name Yuancheng; second in seniority; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Cao Qi; his grandfather was Cao Shen (Honorary Official for Longevity); his father was Cao Xiao (Service Aide in the Court of Imperial Entertainments); his mother was Lady Shen. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Guang (Salt Distribution Commissioner). He married Lady Yao. He placed fifty-third in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

張夢鯉〔貫山西平陽府絳州絳縣軍籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字化龍，行一，年三十四，二月十二日生〕。曾祖縯〔義官〕；祖大車〔貢士〕；父簡；母邵氏，繼母原氏。具慶下。弟夢麒、夢虎。娶陳氏，繼娶藺氏、楊氏。山西鄉試第六十四名，會試第一百九十八名。

郭顯忠〔貫河南開封府太康縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字歩武，行一，年二十七，四月十七日生〕。曾祖存心；祖承美；父效諒；母張氏，繼母王氏。嚴侍下。弟大忠、世忠。娶師氏。河南鄉試第六十名，會試第二百五十二名。
translation_en:
Ma Chongqian 馬崇謙 (registered in a salt-producer household in Anyi County, Xiezhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; supernumerary student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ziyi; first in generational order; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-fifth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Ma Fei ( Assistant Subprefectural Magistrate); his grandfather was Ma Tianyin (Assistant County Magistrate); his father was Ma Shaoying (Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue); his legal mothers were Lady Guo and Lady Yao, and his birth mother is Lady Feng. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Chongjiao, Chonghua, and Chongben. He married Lady Qiao. He placed 43rd in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 143rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Mengli 張夢鯉 (registered in a military household in Jiang County, Jiangzhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Hualong; first in generational order; age thirty-four, born on the twelfth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhang Yin (Honorary Official); his grandfather was Zhang Dache (Tribute Student); his father is Zhang Jian; his mother was Lady Shao, and his stepmother is Lady Yuan. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Mengqi and Menghu. He married Lady Chen, and subsequently married Lady Lin and Lady Yang. He placed 64th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 198th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Gui 高桂 (registered in a military household in Wei County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; supernumerary student of the County School; specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Chongfang; third in generational order; age twenty-two, born on the twelfth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Gao Jing (Honorary Elder); his grandfather is Gao Ming (Assistant Prefect); his father is Gao Ruyu (Directorate Student); his mother is Lady Shi. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brothers are Pu and Zhen, and his younger brothers are Shi and Biao. He married Lady Wang. He placed 31st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 196th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Xianzhong 郭顯忠 (registered in a commoner household in Taikang County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; student of the Directorate of Education; specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Buwu; first in generational order; age twenty-seven, born on the seventeenth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Guo Cunxin; his grandfather was Guo Chengmei; his father is Guo Xiaoliang; his mother was Lady Zhang, and his stepmother was Lady Wang. His father is living while his mother is deceased. His younger brothers are Dazhong and Shizhong. He married Lady Shi. He placed 60th in the Henan Provincial Examination and 252nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

治書經字于健行九年三十九七月十四日生
曾祖克紹 祖伯崇〔贈禮部郎中〕 父存仁〔布政司左布政使〕 母羅氏〔封太夫人〕

punctuated:
張希皐〔貫湖廣德安府安陸縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字直卿，行四，年二十八，七月二十六日生〕。曾祖通；祖崇慶；父巽〔州吏目〕；前母程氏，母朱氏。慈侍下。兄希文、希武、希周，弟希仲。娶楊氏。湖廣鄉試第五十名，會試第一百八十五名。

沈孚聞〔貫直隸蘇州府吳江縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字貞孺，行一，年四十三，三月十二日生〕。曾祖經〔醫學訓科，贈知府〕；祖岱〔監生〕；父理〔監生〕；母黃氏。嚴侍下。弟令善〔監生〕、令成、令猷、嘉聞、季文〔同科進士〕。娶闕氏，繼娶黃氏、顧氏。應天府鄉試第三名，會試第一百二名。

郝潔〔貫山東登州府棲霞縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元玉，行一，年三十一，五月初七日生〕。曾祖亮〔壽官〕；祖繹；父如金〔州判官〕；母孫氏，繼母薄氏。具慶下。弟清。娶殷氏。山東鄉試第三十四名，會試第一百五十七名。

曾乾亨〔貫江西吉安府吉水縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字于健，行九，年三十九，七月十四日生〕。曾祖克紹；祖伯崇〔贈禮部郎中〕；父存仁〔布政司左布政使〕；母羅氏〔封太夫人〕。永感下。兄泰亨〔監生〕、同亨〔都察院右副都御史〕、升亨，弟復亨。娶張氏。江西鄉試第五十名，會試第一百一十五名。
translation_en:
Zhang Xigao 張希皐 [registered as a commoner in Anlu County, De'an Prefecture, Huguang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhiqing, fourth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Tong; his grandfather was Zhang Chongqing; his father was Zhang Xun [Departmental Police Warden]; his father's first wife was née Cheng, and his mother is née Zhu. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Xiwen, Xiwu, and Xizhou, and his younger brother is Xizhong. He married née Yang. He placed fiftieth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Fuwen 沈孚聞 [registered as a commoner in Wujiang County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zhenru, first in seniority among brothers, aged forty-three, born on the twelfth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Jing [ Prefectural Medical School Instructor, posthumously honored as Prefect]; his grandfather was Shen Dai [National University Student]; his father is Shen Li [National University Student]; and his mother was née Huang. His father is living. His younger brothers are Lingshan [National University Student], Lingcheng, Lingyou, Jiawen, and Jiwen [metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the same examination year]. He married née Que, and subsequently married née Huang and née Gu. He placed third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hao Jie 郝潔 [registered as a commoner in Qixia County, Dengzhou Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanyu, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Hao Liang [Honorary Official for Longevity]; his grandfather was Hao Yi; his father is Hao Rujin [Assistant Department Magistrate]; his mother was née Sun, and his stepmother is née Bo. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brother is Qing. He married née Yin. He placed thirty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zeng Qianheng 曾乾亨 [registered as a commoner in Jishui County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yujian, ninth in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zeng Keshao; his grandfather was Zeng Bochong [posthumously honored as Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Rites]; his father was Zeng Cunren [Left Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission]; and his mother was née Luo [invested as Grand Lady]. Both his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Taiheng [National University Student], Tongheng [Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief in the Censorate], and Shengheng, and his younger brother is Fuheng. He married née Zhang. He placed fiftieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

鍾宇淳〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣匠籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字道復，行六，年三十三，二月十二日生〕
曾祖昶；祖玥；父薇；母許氏；繼母顧氏。具慶下。兄梁、集、樞、槩、樂；弟宇粹、宇冲、宇元、宇化、宇禎。娶錢氏。應天府鄉試第三十五名，會試第一百六名。

王士性〔貫浙江台州府臨海縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字恒叔，行一，年三十一，三月初七日生〕
曾祖明；祖閭；父宗果〔王府典膳〕；母林氏。具慶下。弟士崧〔貢士〕、士琦〔貢士〕、士栒。娶趙氏。浙江鄉試第十五名，會試第三十七名。

和震〔貫河南開封府祥符縣民籍，河陰縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字起甫，行三，年三十五，十一月初九日生〕
曾祖睍〔教授〕；祖春〔學正〕；父穎；母王氏。慈侍下。兄雲、靄。娶張氏。河南鄉試第七十九名，會試第二百八十四名。

趙一鵬〔貫直隸蘇州府吳縣民籍，常州府無錫縣人，縣學附學生，治《書經》，字化卿，行二，年二十九，十一月初五日生〕
曾祖榮；祖鳳；父朔；母許氏。慈侍下。兄有威；弟有學、一鶚。娶王氏。應天府鄉試第九十名，會試第五十八名。
translation_en:
Zhong Yuchun 鍾宇淳: Registered in an artisan household in Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Daofu 道復, sixth in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Zhong Chang 昶; his grandfather was Zhong Yue 玥; his father is Zhong Wei 薇; his mother was née Xu 許氏, and his stepmother is née Gu 顧氏. Both parents (father and stepmother) are living. His elder brothers are Zhong Liang 梁, Zhong Ji 集, Zhong Shu 樞, Zhong Gai 槩, and Zhong Le 樂; his younger brothers are Zhong Yucui 宇粹, Zhong Yuchong 宇冲, Zhong Yuyuan 宇元, Zhong Yuhua 宇化, and Zhong Yuzhen 宇禎. He married née Qian 錢氏. He placed thirty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Shixing 王士性: Registered in a commoner household in Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Hengshu 恒叔, first in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-one, born on the seventh day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Wang Ming 明; his grandfather was Wang Lü 閭; his father is Wang Zongguo 宗果 (Director of Food Services in a Princely Establishment 王府典膳); and his mother is née Lin 林氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Shisong 士崧 (Tribute Student 貢士), Wang Shiqi 士琦 (Tribute Student 貢士), and Wang Shixun 士栒. He married née Zhao 趙氏. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang 浙江 Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Zhen 和震: Registered in a commoner household in Xiangfu County 祥符縣, Kaifeng Prefecture 開封府, Henan 河南, native of Heyin County 河陰縣; Student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Qifu 起甫, third in seniority among his brothers, age thirty-five, born on the ninth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was He Xian 睍 (Instructor 教授); his grandfather was He Chun 春 (Director of Studies 學正); his father was He Ying 穎; and his mother is née Wang 王氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are He Yun 雲 and He Ai 靄. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed seventy-ninth in the Henan 河南 Provincial Examination and two hundred eighty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Yipeng 趙一鵬: Registered in a commoner household in Wu County 吳縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area 直隸, native of Wuxi County 無錫縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府; Supplementary Student of the County School (xianxue fuxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Huaqing 化卿, second in seniority among his brothers, age twenty-nine, born on the fifth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhao Rong 榮; his grandfather was Zhao Feng 鳳; his father was Zhao Shuo 朔; and his mother is née Xu 許氏. His mother is living. His elder brother is Zhao Youwei 有威; his younger brothers are Zhao Youxue 有學 and Zhao Yi'e 一鶚. He married née Wang 王氏. He placed ninetieth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄
text:
沈瑞臨〔貫浙江杭州府仁和縣民籍國子生治易經字夢錫行一年三十七十月十七日生〕
曾祖銳〔南京刑部右侍郎贈通議大夫〕祖儀〔府通判〕父恩卿母莫氏

punctuated:
沈瑞臨〔貫浙江杭州府仁和縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字夢錫，行一，年三十七，十月十七日生〕。曾祖銳〔南京刑部右侍郎，贈通議大夫〕；祖儀〔府通判〕；父恩卿；母莫氏。慈侍下。兄乾臨、節臨；弟禮臨、嘉臨、奎臨、祿臨、至臨、簡臨、明臨、傳臨、治臨、昭臨、延臨。娶莫氏，繼娶姜氏。應天府鄉試第二十九名，會試第十六名。

蔡萬里〔貫浙江紹興府蕭山縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字巨卿，行二，年三十一，正月十三日生〕。曾祖寛；祖翼；父時淓；母金氏，繼母孫氏。具慶下。兄萬程；弟萬言、萬善、萬鍾、萬化、萬春。娶周氏，繼娶來氏。浙江鄉試第三十七名，會試第一百六十三名。

魏濬〔貫山東青州府益都縣民籍，福建福州府閩縣人，縣學生，治《詩經》，字象涵，行二，年二十九，二月十七日生〕。曾祖德；祖澄〔教諭〕；父廷秀〔縣丞〕；母薛氏。具慶下。弟濂、潢。娶蕭氏。山東鄉試第十六名，會試第二百二名。

吳之鵬〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，無錫縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字汝南，行一，年三十三，三月二十四日生〕。曾祖元；祖大倫〔陰陽正術〕；父嶔〔府通判〕；母蔣氏。具慶下。弟之美、之芳、之鵠〔儒士〕、之珍、之奎、之城〔貢士〕、之龍、之寶。娶王氏，繼娶王氏。應天府鄉試第一百十四名，會試第一百二十八名。
translation_en:
Shen Ruilin 沈瑞臨 [registered in a civilian household of Renhe County 仁和縣, Hangzhou Prefecture 杭州府, Zhejiang 浙江; Directorate Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Mengxi 夢錫; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-seven; born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Rui 銳 [Right Vice Minister of the Nanjing Ministry of Justice, posthumously granted the prestige title Grand Master for Thorough Counsel]; his grandfather was Shen Yi 儀 [Prefectural Assistant Prefect]; his father was Shen Enqing 恩卿; and his mother is née Mo 莫. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Shen Qianlin 乾臨 and Shen Jielin 節臨; his younger brothers are Shen Lilin 禮臨, Shen Jialin 嘉臨, Shen Kuilin 奎臨, Shen Lulin 祿臨, Shen Zhilin 至臨, Shen Jianlin 簡臨, Shen Minglin 明臨, Shen Chuanlin 傳臨, Shen Zhilin 治臨, Shen Zhaolin 昭臨, and Shen Yanlin 延臨. He married née Mo 莫, and subsequently married née Jiang 姜. He placed twenty-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cai Wanli 蔡萬里 [registered in a military household of Xiaoshan County 蕭山縣, Shaoxing Prefecture 紹興府, Zhejiang; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Juqing 巨卿; second in seniority; age thirty-one; born on the thirteenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Cai Kuan 寛; his grandfather was Cai Yi 翼; his father is Cai Shifang 時淓; his mother was née Jin 金, and his stepmother is née Sun 孫. Both his father and stepmother are living. His elder brother is Cai Wancheng 萬程; his younger brothers are Cai Wanyan 萬言, Cai Wanshan 萬善, Cai Wanzhong 萬鍾, Cai Wanhua 萬化, and Cai Wanchun 萬春. He married née Zhou 周, and subsequently married née Lai 來. He placed thirty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Jun 魏濬 [registered in a civilian household of Yidu County 益都縣, Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong 山東, originally from Min County 閩縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建; County Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Xianghan 象涵; second in seniority; age twenty-nine; born on the seventeenth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Wei De 德; his grandfather was Wei Cheng 澄 [County Instructor]; his father is Wei Tingxiu 廷秀 [Assistant Magistrate]; and his mother is née Xue 薛. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wei Lian 濂 and Wei Huang 潢. He married née Xiao 蕭. He placed sixteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhipeng 吳之鵬 [registered in a civilian household of Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), originally from Wuxi County 無錫縣; Directorate Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Runan 汝南; first in seniority; age thirty-three; born on the twenty-fourth day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Yuan 元; his grandfather was Wu Dalun 大倫 [Prefectural Yin-Yang Superior Master]; his father is Wu Qin 嶔 [Prefectural Assistant Prefect]; and his mother is née Jiang 蔣. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wu Zhimei 之美, Wu Zhifang 之芳, Wu Zhihu 之鵠 [Confucian Scholar (rushi)], Wu Zhizhen 之珍, Wu Zhikui 之奎, Wu Zhicheng 之城 [Tribute Student (gongshi)], Wu Zhilong 之龍, and Wu Zhibao 之寶. He married née Wang 王, and subsequently married née Wang 王. He placed one hundred fourteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Yang Fang 楊芳 [registered under a military household in Chongqing Guard 重慶衛, Sichuan; a District Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yide 以德, first in seniority among brothers, aged thirty, born on the first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yang Yinghe 應和; his grandfather was Yang Tai 泰; his father is Yang Shijin 時進; and his mother is née Di 狄氏. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Yang Zhen 蓁 and Yang Cui 萃; his younger brothers are Yang Fen 芬, Yang Ji 萕, and Yang Ming 茗. He married née Su 蘇氏. He placed 39th in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 285th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Guoxiang 宋國相 [registered under a military household in Bin Subprefecture 濱州, Jinan Prefecture 濟南府, Shandong; an Added Subprefectural Student specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shizuo 時佐, third in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Song Hou 厚; his grandfather was Song Han 漢 [Battalion Recorder]; his father is Song Rong 榮; and his mother is née Du 杜氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Song Guoshi 國士 and Song Guoxian 國賢; his younger brothers are Song Guojun 國俊 and Song Guozhen 國楨. He married née Zhang 張氏. He placed 13th in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 123rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Luo Yongjing 羅用敬 [registered under a civilian household in Nanchang District 南昌縣, Nanchang Prefecture 南昌府, Jiangxi; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zizhi 子直, second in seniority among brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the fifth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Luo Lin 琳; his grandfather was Luo Han 漢; his father was Luo Heng 恒; and his mother is née Gan 甘氏. His mother is living. His younger brother is Luo Yongming 用明. He married née Gong 龔氏, and remarried née Yang 楊氏. He placed 7th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 168th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Jiuyi 王九儀 [registered under a civilian household in Chang'an District 長安縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi; a District Student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Weibang 維邦, fifth in seniority among brothers, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Lin 林; his grandfather was Wang Jing 靖 [District Magistrate]; his father is Wang Peng 鵬 [Tribute Student (gongshi)]; and his mother is née Ma 馬氏. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Jiuguan 九官, Wang Jiuming 九命, Wang Jiugong 九功, and Wang Jiuqing 九卿; his younger brothers are Wang Jiuzhang 九章 and Wang Jiuyou 九有. He married née Zhou 周氏. He placed 26th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 244th in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳堯弼〔貫雲南鶴慶府軍籍，福建福州府閩縣人，府學生，治《書經》，字宗舜，行一，年二十六，五月二十三日生〕。曾祖全；祖繼祖；父仲，母趙氏。重慶下。弟堯相、堯臣。娶龐氏。雲南鄉試第二十七名，會試第二百七十二名。

黃曰謹〔貫福建漳州府鎮海衛軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元祗，行二，年三十三，十月十二日生〕。曾祖德乾；祖璇宗；父繼傳，母李氏。慈侍下。兄曰勤。娶楊氏，繼娶蔡氏。福建鄉試第三十八名，會試第二十五名。

金枝〔貫浙江嘉興府崇德縣軍籍，國子生，治《易經》，字本懋，行一，年三十，七月初六日生〕。曾祖武；祖鉞；父可久，母黃氏。具慶下。弟梁、采、榘、楫。娶吳氏。浙江鄉試第九十名，會試第七十六名。
translation_en:
Chen Bangke 陳邦科 (registered in a civilian household of Gao'an County, Ruizhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; Added Student of the County School; specialized in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Junqing; fourth in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Chen Yong (invested by imperial command as Investigating Censor); his grandfather was Chen Biao; his father is Chen Ruhu, and his mother is née Xu. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Bangyan, and his younger brothers are Bangxuan, Bangkui, Bangjing, Bangyi, and Bangfan. He married née Yu. He ranked thirty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Yaobi 吳堯弼 (registered in a military household of Heqing Prefecture, Yunnan, native of Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Zongshun; first in his generation; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Wu Quan; his grandfather is Wu Jizu; his father is Wu Zhong, and his mother is née Zhao. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His younger brothers are Yaoxiang and Yaochen. He married née Pang. He ranked twenty-seventh in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Yuejin 黃曰謹 (registered in a military household of Zhenhai Guard, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Yuanzhi; second in his generation; age thirty-three, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Deqian; his grandfather was Huang Xuanzong; his father was Huang Jichuan, and his mother is née Li. His mother is living. His elder brother is Yueqin. He married née Yang, and took née Cai as his second wife. He ranked thirty-eighth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jin Zhi 金枝 (registered in a military household of Chongde County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; Student of the Directorate of Education; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Benmao; first in his generation; age thirty, born on the sixth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Jin Wu; his grandfather was Jin Yue; his father is Jin Kejiu, and his mother is née Huang. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Liang, Cai, Ju, and Ji. He married née Wu. He ranked ninetieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and seventy-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

趙邦秩〔貫浙江嘉興府平湖縣竈籍，國子生，治《易經》，字元敘，行三，年二十九，正月二十九日生〕。曾祖璧〔贈兵科給事中〕；祖漢〔布政司左參政，封中大夫〕；父伊〔按察司副使，進階中憲大夫〕；母張氏〔封恭人〕。永感下。兄邦穀、邦穎；弟邦秀、邦程、邦黍〔推官〕、邦栔、邦和、邦穆〔監生〕、邦禾〔監生〕。娶陸氏，繼娶屠氏。浙江鄉試第十一名，會試第十一名。

馬玉麟〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣民籍，長洲縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字德徵，行二，年二十八，三月十八日生〕。曾祖綬；祖淮〔府同知〕；父龍光〔府經歷〕；母王氏。慈侍下。兄玉珂；弟玉堂、玉纓、騰黃、飛黃。娶顧氏。應天府鄉試第九十三名，會試第九十九名。
translation_en:
Tian Rujing 田如京 (registered in a commoner household in Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Zigeng; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-seven, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Tian Jiayou (Administrator of Records in a Princely Establishment), his grandfather was Tian Geng, his father is Tian Yifang (Licentiate with Ceremonial Cap and Belt), and his mother is Lady Chen. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Tian Ruliang and Tian Ruyong. He married Lady Li. He ranked twenty-sixth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Bangzhi 趙邦秩 (registered in a saltern household in Pinghu County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yuanxu; third in seniority among brothers; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Zhao Bi (posthumously honored as Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War), his grandfather was Zhao Han (Left Administration Vice Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission, patented as Grand Master of the Palace), his father was Zhao Yi (Surveillance Vice Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission, advanced in prestige rank to Grand Master Exemplar), and his mother was Lady Zhang (patented as Lady of Respectability). Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brothers are Zhao Banggu and Zhao Bangying; his younger brothers are Zhao Bangxiu, Zhao Bangcheng, Zhao Bangshu (Prefectural Judge), Zhao Bangqie, Zhao Banghe, Zhao Bangmu (National University Student), and Zhao Banghe (National University Student). He married Lady Lu, and later married Lady Tu. He ranked eleventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Pei 傅霈 (registered in a commoner household in Xinzhou, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Yinglin; third in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the twentieth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Fu Tianxi (Prefectural Director of Studies), his grandfather was Fu Kang (National University Student), his father was Fu Chaoxuan (Consort of a Clanswoman), his legal mother is the Commandery Mistress of Langqing, and his birth mother was Lady Yin (posthumously honored as Lady of Suitability). His mother is living (while his father is deceased). His elder brothers are Fu Lin (Assistant Surveillance Commissioner of a Provincial Surveillance Commission) and Fu Zhen (Tribute Student); his younger brother is Fu Ni. He married Lady Yang. He ranked sixty-second in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Yulin 馬玉麟 (registered in a commoner household in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], native of Changzhou County; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Dezheng; second in seniority among brothers; age twenty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Ma Shou, his grandfather was Ma Huai (Prefectural Vice Prefect), his father was Ma Longguang (Prefectural Registrar), and his mother is Lady Wang. His mother is living (while his father is deceased). His elder brother is Ma Yuke; his younger brothers are Ma Yutang, Ma Yuying, Ma Tenghuang, and Ma Feihuang. He married Lady Gu. He ranked ninety-third in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
He Wenji 何文極 (registered in a civilian household in Taihe County, Dali Prefecture, Yunnan; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Meizhong; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the thirteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was He Lu; his grandfather was He Rui; his father was He Qing (District Jailor); and his mother was née Li. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). He married a woman née Li. He placed tenth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lin Guocai 林國材 (registered in a civilian household in Huangyan County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Chongyuan; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Lin Wengang; his grandfather was Lin Jixun; his father was Lin Liangchuan; and his mother was née Zhan. His father is living and his mother is deceased (yanshi xia). His elder brother is Lin Yunshen, and his younger brothers are Lin Yunling and Lin Guoxiang. He married a woman née Wang. He placed twelfth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Liangdong 陳良棟 (registered in a civilian household in Yibin County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan; an expectant student at the county school; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yonglong; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the fifteenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Yongyi; his grandfather was Chen Jinfu; his father was Chen Zhong; and his mother was née Zhang. His mother is living and his father is deceased (cishi xia). His elder brother is Chen Liangshan, and his younger brother is Chen Liangcai. He married a woman née Cheng. He placed thirty-second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and two hundred seventy-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yangshan 陳揚善 (registered in a salt-producer household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; an added student at the county school; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Zongshun; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Chen Ruwen (Honorary Official for Advanced Age); his grandfather was Chen Zaizhong; his father was Chen Run; and his mother was née Yu. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). He married a woman née Lin. He placed twenty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

===
譚耀
貫廣東廣州府東莞縣民籍　府學生
治詩經字章伯行二年三十三九月十七日生
曾祖師誠　祖德明　父世懷　母梁氏

曾祖琦〔府同知進階中順大夫〕　祖興仁〔知縣〕　父益謙〔恩例儒官〕　母王氏
具慶下　兄龍　娶吳氏　繼娶孫氏

punctuated:
陳遇文〔貫山西平陽府解州安邑縣民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字鳴周，行四，年三十五，十月初六日生〕。曾祖通；祖玄；父萬壽〔壽官〕；母侯氏。具慶下。兄遇能、遇堯、遇舜；弟遇湯。娶楊氏，繼娶胡氏。山西鄉試第四名，會試第二百五十八名。

簡繼芳〔貫江西袁州府萍鄉縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字師啓，行一，年三十二，正月二十九日生〕。曾祖鳳翥；祖輔堯〔義官〕；父昌〔壽官〕；母彭氏，繼母賀氏。嚴侍下。娶潘氏。江西鄉試第二十九名，會試第二十三名。

譚耀〔貫廣東廣州府東莞縣民籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字章伯，行二，年三十三，九月十七日生〕。曾祖師誠；祖德明；父世懷；母梁氏。具慶下。兄輝；弟熠。娶房氏。廣東鄉試第二十一名，會試第二百五十七名。

鄧鶴〔貫河南河南府洛陽縣民籍，國子生，治《易經》，字子臯，行二，年三十四，十二月十一日生〕。曾祖琦〔府同知，進階中順大夫〕；祖興仁〔知縣〕；父益謙〔恩例儒官〕；母王氏。具慶下。兄龍。娶吳氏，繼娶孫氏。河南鄉試第十五名，會試第二百十名。
translation_en:
Chen Yuwen 陳遇文 [registered under a civilian household in Anyi County, Xiezhou Subprefecture, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; Student in the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Mingzhou 鳴周; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five; born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Tong 通; his grandfather was Chen Xuan 玄; his father is Chen Wanshou 萬壽 [Longevity Official (shouguan)]; and his mother is Lady Hou 侯氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brothers are Chen Yuneng 遇能, Chen Yuyao 遇堯, and Chen Yushun 遇舜; his younger brother is Chen Yutang 遇湯. He married Lady Yang 楊氏, and subsequently married Lady Hu 胡氏. He ranked fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jian Jifang 簡繼芳 [registered under a civilian household in Pingxiang County, Yuanzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; Student in the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shiqi 師啓; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two; born on the twenty-ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Jian Fengzhu 鳳翥; his grandfather was Jian Fuyao 輔堯 [Public-spirited Official (yiguan)]; his father is Jian Chang 昌 [Longevity Official (shouguan)]; his mother was Lady Peng 彭氏, and his stepmother was Lady He 賀氏. His father is living. He married Lady Pan 潘氏. He ranked twenty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Yao 譚耀 [registered under a civilian household in Dongguan County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong; Prefectural Student (fuxuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zhangbo 章伯; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-three; born on the seventeenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Shicheng 師誠; his grandfather was Tan Deming 德明; his father is Tan Shihuai 世懷; and his mother is Lady Liang 梁氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Tan Hui 輝; his younger brother is Tan Yi 熠. He married Lady Fang 房氏. He ranked twenty-first in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and two hundred fifty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Deng He 鄧鶴 [registered under a civilian household in Luoyang County, Henan Prefecture, Henan; Student in the Directorate of Imperial Academy (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zigao 子臯; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-four; born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Deng Qi 琦 [Vice Prefect (fu tongzhi), advanced in prestige title to Grand Master of Palace Accord (zhongshun dafu)]; his grandfather was Deng Xingren 興仁 [County Magistrate (zhixian)]; his father is Deng Yiqian 益謙 [Confucian Official by Special Grace (enli ruguan)]; and his mother is Lady Wang 王氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Deng Long 龍. He married Lady Wu 吳氏, and subsequently married Lady Sun 孫氏. He ranked fifteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and two hundred tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

盧逵〔貫江西贛州府寧都縣匠籍，國子生，治《易經》，字秉漸，行二，年三十三，正月十九日生〕。曾祖子欽；祖日秀；父景鵬，母賴氏。具慶下。兄通〔貢士〕。娶彭氏。江西鄉試第三十九名，會試第一百四十六名。

黃鍾〔貫直隸蘇州府長洲縣民籍，吳縣人，國子生，治《易經》，字律元，行一，年三十二，十月初二日生〕。曾祖道規；祖慶；父臣，母周氏。慈侍下。弟鉉。娶周氏。應天府鄉試第九十五名，會試第一百十名。

向俁〔貫雲南臨安衛籍，湖廣辰州府黔陽縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字良佐，行二，年三十一，九月初二日生〕。曾祖祿；祖秀；父本惠，母柴氏。慈侍下。兄儒，弟倫。娶石氏。雲南鄉試第三十八名，會試第二百九十四名。

黃衮〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字補甫，行一，年二十六，九月二十四日生〕。曾祖漳〔府通判〕；祖應策〔府推官〕；父其昌，母林氏，繼母郭氏。重慶下。弟襄、哀、扆、衷、褒、裳、袤、裘。娶劉氏。福建鄉試第四十一名，會試第六十二名。
translation_en:
Lu Kui 盧逵 (registered in an artisan household in Ningdu County, Ganzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Bingjian; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Lu Ziqin; his grandfather was Lu Rixiu; his father is Lu Jingpeng, and his mother is née Lai. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Lu Tong (tribute scholar [gongshi]). He married née Peng. He placed thirty-ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Zhong 黃鍾 (registered in a commoner household in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], originally from Wu County; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Lüyuan; first in seniority among brothers; age thirty-two, born on the second day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Daogui; his grandfather was Huang Qing; his father was Huang Chen, and his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living. He has a younger brother, Huang Xuan. He married née Zhou. He placed ninety-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiang Yu 向俁 (registered in a military household in Lin'an Guard, Yunnan, originally from Qianyang County, Chenzhou Prefecture, Huguang; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Liangzuo; second in seniority among brothers; age thirty-one, born on the second day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Xiang Lu; his grandfather was Xiang Xiu; his father was Xiang Benhui, and his mother is née Chai. His mother is living. He has an elder brother, Xiang Ru, and a younger brother, Xiang Lun. He married née Shi. He placed thirty-eighth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and two hundred ninety-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Gun 黃衮 (registered in a commoner household in Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Bufu; first in seniority among brothers; age twenty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month). His great-grandfather was Huang Zhang (Prefectural Assistant Prefect); his grandfather is Huang Yingce (Prefectural Judge); his father is Huang Qichang, his mother was née Lin, and his stepmother is née Guo. Both his grandparents and parents are living. He has younger brothers: Huang Xiang, Huang Ai [?], Huang Yi, Huang Zhong, Huang Bao, Huang Chang, Huang Mao, and Huang Qiu. He married née Liu. He placed forty-first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

徐聯芳〔貫直隸保定府博野縣民籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字元實，行一，年二十七，十月二十二日生〕。曾祖廷璋〔省祭官〕；祖鸞〔王府長史〕；父行〔布政司左布政使〕，母陳氏〔封宜人〕。具慶下。娶韓氏，繼娶韓氏。順天府鄉試第五十九名，會試第二百八十八名。

程奎〔貫直隸徽州府歙縣民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字國光，行三，年二十八，六月初三日生〕。曾祖太生；祖積興；父廷壽，母凌氏。慈侍下。兄輅、輖。娶朱氏。應天府鄉試第一百十一名，會試第二百五十一名。

陳與相〔貫浙江杭州府海寧縣竈籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字卜野，行二，年二十六，十月二十八日生〕。曾祖晃；祖經〔壽官〕；父中漸，母嚴氏。慈侍下。兄與言、與立、與郊〔進士〕、與文，弟日新、與侯、與伯。娶吳氏，繼娶王氏。浙江鄉試第三十六名，會試第四十一名。

苗朝陽〔貫山西太原府河曲縣軍籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字遇之，行一，年三十五，九月十五日生〕。曾祖友；祖世用；父鳳，母何氏。具慶下。兄向陽，弟煥陽、應陽、在陽、鳴陽、秋陽。娶李氏。山西鄉試第十名，會試第一百五名。
translation_en:
Xu Lianfang 徐聯芳 [registered in a civilian household of Boye County, Baoding Prefecture, Zhili; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yuanshi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Xu Tingzhang [Sacrificial Attendant (shengji guan)]; his grandfather was Xu Luan [Chief Administrator of a Princely Establishment (wangfu zhangshi)]; his father is Xu Xing [Left Administration Commissioner of a Provincial Administration Commission (buzhengsi zuo buzhengshi)]; and his mother is Lady Chen [invested as Lady of Suitability (yiren)]. Both of his parents are living. He married Lady Han, and after her death married another Lady Han. He placed 59th in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 288th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cheng Kui 程奎 [registered in a civilian household of She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili; an Expectant Student (fuxuesheng) of the County School specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Guoguang; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the third day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Cheng Taisheng; his grandfather was Cheng Jixing; his father was Cheng Tingshou; and his mother is Lady Ling. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Cheng Lu and Cheng Zhou. He married Lady Zhu. He placed 111th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 251st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Chen Yuxiang 陳與相 [registered in a saltern household of Haining County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang; a National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Boye; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-eighth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Chen Huang; his grandfather was Chen Jing [Honorary Official for Longevity (shouguan)]; his father was Chen Zhongjian; and his mother is Lady Yan. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Chen Yuyan, Chen Yuli, Chen Yujiao [metropolitan graduate (jinshi)], and Chen Yuwen; his younger brothers are Chen Rixin, Chen Yuhou, and Chen Yubo. He married Lady Wu, and after her death married Lady Wang. He placed 36th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 41st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Miao Chaoyang 苗朝陽 [registered in a military household of Hequ County, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi; a County School Student (xian xuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Yuzhi; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the fifteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Miao You; his grandfather was Miao Shiyong; his father is Miao Feng; and his mother is Lady He. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Miao Xiangyang, and his younger brothers are Miao Huanyang, Miao Yingyang, Miao Zaiyang, Miao Mingyang, and Miao Qiuyang. He married Lady Li. He placed 10th in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 105th in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 萬曆五年進士登科錄
text:

李載陽〔貫湖廣黃州府蘄州軍籍，州學生，治《易經》，字子春，行一，年二十八，九月二十八日生〕。曾祖栢；祖時言〔知州，進階中憲大夫〕；父元英；母姜氏；繼母鄧氏。重慶下。弟承陽、應陽、得陽、泰陽。娶化氏。湖廣鄉試第二十名，會試第二百十八名。

趙夢日〔貫浙江紹興府會稽縣籍，山陰縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字應瑞，行十四，年三十三，十二月二十五日生〕。曾祖祺〔七品散官〕；祖溥；父棠；母周氏。具慶下。兄夢鳳〔知縣〕、完〔通判〕、夢罷、夢鵷〔監生〕；弟夢鴻、夢雷、夢斗、夢鶚、夢魁。娶夏氏。順天府鄉試第十名，會試第二百十八名。
